## Context

### Context

This repository contains Promptbook landing pages for different businesses,
use cases, and audiences. Keep these rules current when behavior changes.

#### Public routes

- `/` redirects to `/cs` or `/en` using `Accept-Language`.
- `/cs` is the Czech homepage and source of truth for homepage structure and copy.
- `/en` is its English localization.
- `/pro-mesta`, `/pro-firmy`, `/for-agro`, `/for-industry`, `/ai-supervize`,
  `/hackathon-factory`, and `/pavol` are specialized landing pages. `/pavol`
  redirects to `/cs/pavol` or `/en/pavol`; the localized pages are Pavol Hejny's
  personal pages.
- `/ai-supervize-mini` is the Czech one-day AI Supervize page. Published terms,
  prices, capacities, places, FAQs, registration, and participant information
  come from `/admin/workshops`; with no published term it shows a notice.
  `/skoleni` redirects there.
- `/cs/online-workshop` lists free 60-minute online workshops about writing
  production code with AI agents. Each term has its own subject and description,
  but all use one registration form. `/cs/online-workshop/dekujeme` is the
  full-load conversion page; `/participant` is the live room. Its waiting room
  offers every published term as the same term cards the landing page registers
  with: running and upcoming ones first, finished ones behind a disclosure.
  Picking one changes the room being connected to and the `workshop` parameter,
  without losing the name and e-mail already typed. Once a term has its recorded
  end, its participant wrap-up offers a locally generated PDF using only the
  attendee-visible description, key takeaways and shared materials; it creates
  no administrative setting or database record.
- `/ai-ta-krajta` reads episodes hourly from podcast RSS and YouTube feeds and
  merges their host rosters with `businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaEpisodes.json`. Its shared platform list exposes
  the publisher's direct RSS feed for custom podcast applications, and page metadata advertises it as
  `application/rss+xml`.
  Each episode lists every credited person by name, and every person any source
  credits has a card in `aiTaKrajtaPeople.ts`, which a test keeps in step, so a
  credited person never misses their portrait and the filter cannot lose them.
  It keeps exact episode counts but labels subscriptions and listening hours as
  estimates. The fixed mini-player, newest-episode header button, person/search/
  episode/play/archive/collaboration filters, and section hash are shareable as
  query/hash state; the snake game is local state. Person clicks filter episodes.
  Everyone in the roster shows a normalized, transparent PNG portrait. The source
  crop is recorded by `scripts/_cutAiTaKrajtaPeoplePortraits.mjs`, from the
  episode cover the show itself published them on or from the picture they publish
  of themselves when no cover carries them; the final alpha PNG is named by the
  roster and a test verifies its format and transparent pixels. Portrait frames
  supply subtle, stable neutral-gradient variations and a restrained hover cue,
  so photographed backgrounds never compete with the page. The one people list
  is drawn anew
  for every visit, weighted by how many episodes of the archive name each
  person, so somebody heard often comes up high far more often than someone in
  one díl without the list ever becoming a ranking. The draw is local state and
  is made in the browser; the page itself is built in the order the draw leans
  towards, from the most often named person to the least often named one, so the
  browser hydrates into the list it was sent.
  Collaboration submissions use `/admin/contacts`. Its tab icon is the page's
  own snake drawing in `/ai-ta-krajta/logo.svg` and `.png`; SVG corners are
  rounded and transparent, while the raster fills its square. That drawing is
  traced off the cover artwork of the show and recorded once in
  `businesses/ai-ta-krajta/aiTaKrajtaMarkArtwork.ts`, together with the
  measurements of the animal along its own length. The snake of the minigame
  starts in exactly that shape, in the frame the still logo occupied, and only
  then eases into the proportions, colours and speed of a game snake.
  A seven-cell Promptbook coder terminal floats in the bottom-right corner and
  clears the player and cookie controls. It types `$ ptbk`, then animates an
  ASCII octopus in response to pointer, focus, scrolling, and the snake terrarium.
  It stays still for reduced motion and pauses its clock in hidden tabs. The
  badge and the shared footer credit link to `https://coder.ptbk.io/`.
- `/ai-ta-krajta/media-kit` and `/ai-ta-krajta/branding` are the two pages beside
  the podcast. They are named once, in `AI_TA_KRAJTA_SUBPAGES`, which the footer
  lists and which they point at each other through, so no link can name a page
  differently than the page names itself. Both wear the same compact header,
  section heading and footer as each other. The brand kit hands out the logo the
  site already serves at `/ai-ta-krajta/logo.svg`, `.png` and the cover artwork,
  publishes no colour outside `AI_TA_KRAJTA_COLORS`, and says how the name is
  written; it asks for nothing and sends visitors to the media-kit form.
- `/cs/komunita` is the permanent Czech community room. It has chat, polls,
  projects, materials, and published terms, but no schedule, stage, or live
  updates. Terms show event kind, format/place, price, and status. A term with a
  live room links there; otherwise it links to its landing page. The calendar
  opens on the member's month, can filter by day, and uses the same terms and
  statuses as the cards. Empty days cannot be selected; an empty month is only
  selected when the member's month has no terms. The room offers Google Calendar
  and `webcal:` subscriptions.
- `/cs/komunita/projects` is the full project gallery, ordered by upvotes.
  `/cs/komunita/projects/<project_id>` shows scraped project details and a
  moderated discussion. Project-room sessions derive from the community session;
  the author moderates their own discussion.
- `/cs/komunita/clenstvi` offers free community access and the 199 Kč monthly
  membership. Webinars remain free; paid access adds recordings, archive,
  materials, extra content, priority questions, and Discord/community features.
  The page is prefilled from `fullname` and `email`, supports community discount
  codes, has no new annual plan or trial, and allows cancellation.
- `/cs/komunita/calendar.ics` publishes the same terms by stable slug, so moved
  or renamed terms update existing subscriptions. It contains only event terms
  and public destinations, never subscriber identity.
- `/admin/workshops` manages terms of every event kind, participants, comments,
  reactions, content, attached community polls, and settings. Every term says both
  of its audiences: the people registered on the landing page of its event, and
  the people who entered its room. A room which is no term of an event says
  nothing about registrations at all. The registration block opens the exact
  filtered `/admin/contacts` list and its shared CSV, vCard, and Book exports;
  it never creates a second contact table or serializer in workshop administration.
- `/admin/community` manages the permanent community, including polls, project
  moderation, participants, memberships, payments, and room analytics.
- `/admin/shortener` manages public short links, QR/UTM output, destinations,
  notes, search/filter/sort state, and private click history. Links are served
  by `/[shortcode]`; `/shortener` redirects to the admin page.
- `/admin/login` authenticates the single `admin` account with `ADMIN_PASSWORD`
  and a signed session cookie. All `/admin/*` pages and APIs require
  `requireAdminSignedIn`. `/admin` is the post-login dashboard.
- Other public/legal routes include `/contact`, `/data-deletion`, `/privacy`,
  `/terms`, `/dekujeme`, `/branding`, and the routes under `/k`, `/old`, and
  `/test`.

#### Shared community and workshop behavior

- Rooms lead to each other in both directions, through one identity hand-off. The
  community lists the terms and opens the room of each; an invited workshop room
  places its community link beside its materials as a special material for every
  participant, regardless of paid membership. Where a special material sits is
  decided once, in `lib/workshops/workshopSpecialMaterials.ts`: a card says where
  among the ordinary materials it belongs, and the invitation opens the material
  list of a participant who does not pay while it closes the list of a paying
  member. A membership which is not loaded yet leaves it where a participant who
  does not pay reads it. Both carry the connected member's
  name and email on, and an incomplete identity carries nothing rather than half
  of it. Which rooms invite is answered by
  `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`; the community and project
  discussions do not. The invitation names the community's sections by the names
  the community itself uses.
- Community polls attached to workshops are shared. A normalized email gives a
  member one vote across the community and all attached workshops. An
  administrator can enable an Other answer: a member-written response becomes
  one shared, anonymous option and receives that member's vote atomically, so
  every room can vote for it; later poll edits keep member-written answers.
  Workshops may display and accept votes, but the community owns administration.
- The participant room owns the membership badge and popup. Community and live
  workshop rooms use the same membership for the connecting email, and checkout
  returns to the room where it started. Membership is offered only by room kinds
  listed in `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`; project discussions do
  not offer it.
- Members can open Stripe Customer Portal from the popup. In-app cancellation
  stops only the next renewal, preserves access through the paid period, appears
  in the badge, and can be reversed before that period ends.
- A full-price-for-the-whole-term discount is a voucher: atomically consume it,
  create membership immediately, ask for no card, and create no Stripe renewal.
  A limited-month discount still opens checkout because the regular price returns.
  Stripe webhooks update completed, cancelled, failed, and late payments. With no
  Stripe key, hide membership; with test keys, identify the test payment gate.
- Community projects use a URL-first metadata wizard. Ordinary submissions await
  moderation; trusted members and moderators are approved immediately. Pending
  projects remain visible to their author and moderators.
- A live workshop room has countdown, YouTube stage, reactions, watching count,
  moderated chat, timed materials, and attached poll aggregates. An open-ended
  term runs until its recorded end; its stage does not end automatically. Admins
  can select, replace, clear, or create the displayed comment through the same
  private realtime channel used by reactions.
- A term can be about a project. The connection is one value — GitHub repository,
  the default branch, and one or more branch patterns such as `main`, `client-*`,
  `feature/*`, or `*` for all branches, plus an optional deployment URL — so it is
  set, changed, and unset at once and neither branch selection nor deployment
  outlives its repository. Room kinds which offer it are named in
  `lib/workshops/workshopKindCapabilities.ts`. The room shows the repository as a
  special material beside its ordinary materials for every participant, with its
  links and newest commits, marking those which arrive while a participant watches;
  a newly found commit is broadcast to active rooms and appears on the stage for
  ten seconds. A selection resolving to multiple branches is shown as a commit
  graph. Commits come from the public commit feed or keyless API, pooled once per
  server and cached through the revalidation window; an unreadable feed still
  leaves the room naming its project.
- A workshop can carry one public presentation URL for a PDF, PowerPoint file, or
  GitHub Markdown page. The room renders it beside ordinary materials through the
  shared material card, primary action, and QR code, for every participant without
  making it timed or membership-gated content.
- Paid-only materials are decided on the server in one pass. Members receive
  unlocked material; others receive only the published titles as an offer. An
  untitled item is not named, items are not named before their unlock time, and a
  room without membership hides paid-only items without naming them.
- After a workshop ends, its recording is server-gated to members. Others receive
  the published teaser, or a generic offer when no teaser exists; a term without
  a recording offers nothing. An administrator can set the recording's start
  offset in seconds, which applies only to that paid replay and never to the
  countdown or live stream.
- Trusted participants remain invisible and their messages are auto-approved.
  Moderators see pending messages, can approve/reject/correct/pin them, and can
  trust or silence authors. Workshop and community moderators are appointed in
  `/admin/workshops`; project authors moderate their own discussions.
- The room records whether each open browser is actively or passively attended
  from pointer, typing, scroll, and touch activity. Admin analytics distinguish
  active computer users from merely open tabs with dashed audience lines.
- The community's compact gallery shows its five highest-upvoted approved projects
  and links to the full gallery. Community landing content is read from the live
  room: expose only anonymous totals, approved messages, and shared projects;
  show member first names only. If the room cannot be read, show less content,
  not an error. Landing-page reactions are estimates based on recent room data.

#### Administration and data rules

- Event kinds are defined once in `lib/events/eventTypes.ts`; adding one should
  not require database migration or page-specific duplication. Terms ask for kind,
  online/place format, price, and capacity. Each kind also names where its landing
  page records registrations, which is the `placeName` of the contacts it gathers.
- Which term a registration belongs to is decided once, in
  `lib/workshops/workshopRegistrations.ts`. A term is recognised by its slug, by
  its Prague day, and by the moment it begins at, so registrations written before
  terms had slugs keep counting. Registration forms write the term through the
  same line prefixes that rule reads back. Contacts are still gathered, recorded
  and shown only by `/admin/contacts`; counting reads nothing but their notes.
  The registration actions in workshop administration carry that same term filter
  into the contacts list and its exports.
- Workshop polls are read-only in workshop administration. Creating a new event
  publishes it by default; duplicating an event keeps it published unless the
  source is unpublished. Duplicating a workshop preserves its connections to
  the already existing attached polls; it creates no polls, options, votes, or room history. Stage settings contain
  the live stream, paid-recording start offset, and recording teaser; presentation settings the public presentation
  address, and project settings the repository the term is about, written as an
  address or as `owner/name`, together with its branch patterns. Deleting a workshop is a soft deletion: its room
  data and attached
  community polls stay stored, but the term leaves normal public and administrative
  lists and no longer holds its slug for a replacement. An end may be empty;
  admins can record, adjust, clear, and reopen it. Overview analytics are zoomable and share their
  room, section, lines, reaction, zoom, and keyword metrics through query params.
- Community administration is the workshop dashboard restricted to the
  `community` room kind: no room picker, schedule, stage, reactions, or address.
  Its membership view filters Stripe lifecycle, prices, discounts, identifiers,
  dates, test/live mode, and links to the exact Stripe checkout/subscription.
  Community analytics cover all measured time and member details show seen times.
- Shortener search, provenance filters, sorting, and selected click history live
  in GET parameters. Editing changes only shortcode, destinations, note, and
  landing page; deletion also deletes recorded clicks.

#### Database and verification

- Put database changes in `migrations/*.sql`. Startup and
  `npm run migrate-database` run `_initialize.sql`, then migrations in filename
  order, recording immutable filenames and checksums in `public."Migration"`.
  Changed or missing migrations fail, as do queries requiring an unapplied one.
- `npm run test-types` must build before `tsc` to refresh `.next/types`.
- `npm run test-e2e` uses the Next.js development server; first-request compile
  headroom belongs in `playwright.config.ts`, not individual tests. E2E tests are
  independent and each archives one recording in `tests/e2e/videos/`, retaining
  only recent runs.

{ AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_WORKSHOP_REGISTRATION_PLACE_NAME } from '@/businesses/ai-supervize-mini/config';\nimport {\n    ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH,\n    ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PATH,\n which\n     *       an event does not have.\n     */\n    readonly participantPath: string | null;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every kind of event together with what it is\n *\n * Note: This is the one place a {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NWXEGBePScNrGE2jczNLsy","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { isEventLocationKind, type EventLocationKind } from '@/lib/events/eventLocation';\n2\timport { isEventType, type EventType } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\n3\t\n4\t/**\n5\t * What one term of a public event is, beside the moment it happens at\n6\t *\n7\t * Note: Only a room which happens at a time is an event. A permanent room such as the community has none of this,\n8\t *       which is why every occurrence carries it and every other room carries `null` instead.\n9\t */\n10\texport type EventDetails = {\n11\t    /**\n12\t     * The kind of event this term is, which decides the landing page it is listed on\n13\t     */\n14\t    readonly type: EventType;\n15\t    readonly locationKind: EventLocationKind;\n16\t\n17\t    /**\n18\t     * Where a term is held, which only a term held somewhere has\n19\t     */\n20\t    readonly locationLabel: string;\n21\t\n22\t    /**\n23\t     * The price of one seat, where zero is a free event\n24\t     */\n25\t    readonly priceCzk: number;\n26\t\n27\t    /**\n28\t     * How many people fit into this term, or `null` when nobody has to be turned away\n29\t     */\n30\t    readonly maximumParticipantCount: number | null;\n31\t};\n32\t\n33\t/**\n34\t * What a term of an event is before anybody describes it: a free online term of the workshop everybody starts with\n35\t */\n36\texport const DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS: EventDetails = {\n37\t    type: 'online-workshop',\n38\t    locationKind: 'online',\n39\t    locationLabel: '',\n40\t    priceCzk: 0,\n41\t    maximumParticipantCount: null,\n42\t};\n43\t\n44\t/**\n45\t * The stored event fields of one room, as far as they can be trusted\n46\t *\n47\t * Note: A room which is not an event has no event fields at all, and a stored kind of event or place which the\n48\t *       application does not know is deliberately read as no event rather than as a made-up one, so nothing lists a\n49\t *       term it could not describe.\n50\t */\n51\texport function createEventDetailsOrNull(values: {\n52\t    readonly type: string | null;\n53\t    readonly locationKind: string | null;\n54\t    readonly locationLabel: string;\n55\t    readonly priceCzk: number | null;\n56\t    readonly maximumParticipantCount: number | null;\n57\t}): EventDetails | null {\n58\t    const { type, {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0111MDS17B1AdViuiKttv6mC","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { getEventTypeDefinition } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\n2\timport { createWorkshopRoomLink, type WorkshopParticipantIdentity } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopParticipantLink';\n3\timport type { WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n4\t\n5\t/**\n6\t * Nobody in particular, which is who a publicly published link is built for\n7\t */\n8\tconst ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY: WorkshopParticipantIdentity = { email: '', fullname: '' };\n9\t\n10\t/**\n11\t * Where one term of an event leads a member who is already connected somewhere else\n12\t *\n13\t * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the\n14\t *       room never asks for it again. A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n15\t *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n16\t * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n17\t *       different kind of event.\n18\t */\n19\texport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n20\t    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n21\t    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n22\t): string | null {\n23\t    if (workshop.event === null) {\n24\t        return null;\n25\t    }\n26\t\n27\t    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n28\t\n29\t    return participantPath === null\n30\t        ? landingPagePath\n31\t        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n32\t}\n33\t\n34\t/**\n35\t * Where one term leads everybody, which is the same destination without the identity of any member\n36\t *\n37\t * Note: This is what a published calendar carries, because such a calendar is read by whoever subscribed to it and by\n38\t *       every calendar application on the way. It never names the member it was downloaded by.\n39\t */\n40\texport function createPublicEventLinkOrNull(workshop: WorkshopSummary): string | null {\n41\t    return createEventLinkOrNull(workshop, ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY);\n42\t}\n43\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b7f2cd13-2785-4eb5-97ae-c4b928f3773c","uuid":"c610c90f-cc99-40d8-b5a4-8f5ddc59629c","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:03:58.123Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\events\\eventLinks.ts","content":"import { getEventTypeDefinition } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\nimport { createWorkshopRoomLink, type WorkshopParticipantIdentity } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopParticipantLink';\nimport type { WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n\n/**\n * Nobody in particular, which is who a publicly published link is built for\n */\nconst ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY: WorkshopParticipantIdentity = { email: '', fullname: '' };\n\n/**\n * Where one term of an event leads a member who is already connected somewhere else\n *\n * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the\n *       room never asks for it again. A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n *       different kind of event.\n */\nexport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n): string | null {\n    if (workshop.event === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n\n    return participantPath === null\n        ? landingPagePath\n        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n}\n\n/**\n * Where one term leads everybody, which is the same destination without the identity of any member\n *\n * Note: This is what a published calendar carries, because such a calendar is read by whoever subscribed to it and by\n *       every calendar application on the way. It never names the member it was downloaded by.\n */\nexport function createPublicEventLinkOrNull(workshop: WorkshopSummary): string | null {\n    return createEventLinkOrNull(workshop, ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY);\n}\n","numLines":43,"startLine":1,"totalLines":43}}}

from '@/lib/events/eventPrice';\nimport {\n    formatCzechWorkshopDay,\n    formatCzechWorkshopDayAndMonth,\n    formatCzechWorkshopTimeRange,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDate';\n\nconst {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01SscKRn6yYSFcDCxvaPJYJ5","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t/**\n2\t * Whether a term is held somewhere or online, which is the one choice every event makes about its place\n3\t */\n4\texport const EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES = ['online', 'onsite'] as const;\n5\t\n6\texport type EventLocationKind = (typeof EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES)[number];\n7\t\n8\texport function isEventLocationKind(value: string): value is EventLocationKind {\n9\t    return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES.includes(value as EventLocationKind);\n10\t}\n11\t\n12\texport const EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS: Readonly<Record<EventLocationKind, string>> = {\n13\t    online: 'Online',\n14\t    onsite: 'Prezenčně',\n15\t};\n16\t\n17\t/**\n18\t * Where one term is held, as a visitor reads it\n19\t *\n20\t * Note: An online term has nowhere to be, so it is named by its form. A term held somewhere is named by that place,\n21\t *       because the place is what a visitor needs to travel to.\n22\t */\n23\texport function formatEventLocation(event: {\n24\t    readonly locationKind: EventLocationKind;\n25\t    readonly locationLabel: string;\n26\t}): string {\n27\t    if (event.locationKind === 'online') {\n28\t        return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.online;\n29\t    }\n30\t\n31\t    return event.locationLabel.trim() || EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.onsite;\n32\t}\n33\t\n34\t/**\n35\t * The form of one term together with its place, for example `Prezenčně · Praha`\n36\t *\n37\t * Note: The place of a term is written by an administrator, so it is never declined into a sentence. It is named\n38\t *       beside the form of the term instead, which reads correctly whatever place is written there.\n39\t */\n40\texport function formatEventFormat(event: {\n41\t    readonly locationKind: EventLocationKind;\n42\t    readonly locationLabel: string;\n43\t}): string {\n44\t    const locationLabel = event.locationLabel.trim();\n45\t    if (event.locationKind === 'online' || locationLabel === '') {\n46\t        return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS[event.locationKind];\n47\t    }\n48\t\n49\t    return `${EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.onsite} · ${locationLabel}`;\n50\t}\n51\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b7f2cd13-2785-4eb5-97ae-c4b928f3773c","uuid":"314dbd30-821d-4438-b973-ebdb7efcdd72","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:04:02.074Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\events\\eventLocation.ts","content":"/**\n * Whether a term is held somewhere or online, which is the one choice every event makes about its place\n */\nexport const EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES = ['online', 'onsite'] as const;\n\nexport type EventLocationKind = (typeof EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES)[number];\n\nexport function isEventLocationKind(value: string): value is EventLocationKind {\n    return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES.includes(value as EventLocationKind);\n}\n\nexport const EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS: Readonly<Record<EventLocationKind, string>> = {\n    online: 'Online',\n    onsite: 'Prezenčně',\n};\n\n/**\n * Where one term is held, as a visitor reads it\n *\n * Note: An online term has nowhere to be, so it is named by its form. A term held somewhere is named by that place,\n *       because the place is what a visitor needs to travel to.\n */\nexport function formatEventLocation(event: {\n    readonly locationKind: EventLocationKind;\n    readonly locationLabel: string;\n}): string {\n    if (event.locationKind === 'online') {\n        return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.online;\n    }\n\n    return event.locationLabel.trim() || EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.onsite;\n}\n\n/**\n * The form of one term together with its place, for example `Prezenčně · Praha`\n *\n * Note: The place of a term is written by an administrator, so it is never declined into a sentence. It is named\n *       beside the form of the term instead, which reads correctly whatever place is written there.\n */\nexport function formatEventFormat(event: {\n    readonly locationKind: EventLocationKind;\n    readonly locationLabel: string;\n}): string {\n    const locationLabel = event.locationLabel.trim();\n    if (event.locationKind === 'online' || locationLabel === '') {\n        return EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS[event.locationKind];\n    }\n\n    return `${EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS.onsite} · ${locationLabel}`;\n}\n","numLines":51,"startLine":1,"totalLines":51}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01UWigSasoz8er41WSbzr4YF","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { selectEventOccurrences, type EventOccurrence } from '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\n2\timport type { EventType } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\n3\timport {\n4\t    findPublishedCommunity,\n5\t    findPublishedWorkshops,\n6\t    findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop,\n7\t    findUpcomingPublishedWorkshops,\n8\t    findWorkshopBySlug,\n9\t    getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull,\n10\t    mapWorkshopRow,\n11\t    mapWorkshopSummaryRow,\n12\t} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDatabase';\n13\timport type { WorkshopDetails, WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n14\t\n15\t/**\n16\t * Loads every term of one kind of event which visitors can still register for. A missing workshop database\n17\t * deliberately looks like no listed terms instead of exposing internal configuration details on the public landing\n18\t * page.\n19\t */\n20\texport async function loadUpcomingPublishedEventSummaries(\n21\t    eventType: EventType,\n22\t): Promise<readonly EventOccurrence[]> {\n23\t    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n24\t    if (supabase === null) {\n25\t        return [];\n26\t    }\n27\t\n28\t    const workshopRows = await findUpcomingPublishedWorkshops(supabase, eventType);\n29\t    return selectEventOccurrences(workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow));\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t/**\n33\t * Loads every published term of one kind of event, including the ones which are running right now and the ones which\n34\t * are already over. A missing workshop database deliberately looks like no listed terms, exactly as it does on the\n35\t * public landing page of that event.\n36\t *\n37\t * Note: This is what a room offers a participant to choose from, so it deliberately says more than the landing page\n38\t *       of the same event does. A term is worth entering while it runs and long after it ended, while only a term\n39\t *       which has not started yet is worth registering for.\n40\t */\n41\texport async function loadPublishedEventSummaries(eventType: EventType): Promise<readonly EventOccurrence[]> {\n42\t    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n43\t    if (supabase === null) {\n44\t        return [];\n45\t    }\n46\t\n47\t    const workshopRows = await findPublishedWorkshops(supabase, eventType);\n48\t    return selectEventOccurrences(workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow));\n49\t}\n50\t\n51\t/**\n52\t * Resolves a published occurrence of one kind of event selected by the URL. Legacy links without a selection\n53\t * deliberately enter the most recent published occurrence of that event, while an explicitly unknown slug never\n54\t * silently opens a different workshop.\n55\t */\n56\texport async function loadSelectedPublishedWorkshop(\n57\t    requestedWorkshopSlug: string | null,\n58\t    eventType: EventType,\n59\t): Promise<WorkshopDetails | null> {\n60\t    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n61\t    if (supabase === null) {\n62\t        return null;\n63\t    }\n64\t\n65\t    const workshopRow =\n66\t        requestedWorkshopSlug === null\n67\t            ? await findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop(supabase, eventType)\n68\t            : await findWorkshopBySlug(supabase, requestedWorkshopSlug, true);\n69\t\n70\t    if (workshopRow === null || workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' || workshopRow.event_type !== eventType) {\n71\t        return null;\n72\t    }\n73\t\n74\t    return mapWorkshopRow(workshopRow);\n75\t}\n76\t\n77\t/**\n78\t * Loads the one published community room. Its data model is shared with workshops so participants get the same\n79\t * secure live-room capabilities without a second copy of the session and moderation model.\n80\t */\n81\texport async function loadPublishedCommunity(): Promise<WorkshopDetails | null> {\n82\t    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n83\t    if (supabase === null) {\n84\t        return null;\n85\t    }\n86\t\n87\t    const communityRow = await findPublishedCommunity(supabase);\n88\t    return communityRow === null ? null : mapWorkshopRow(communityRow);\n89\t}\n90\t\n91\t/**\n92\t * Lists every published term of every kind of event for the community, including past terms but never the community\n93\t * room itself or unpublished drafts.\n94\t */\n95\texport async function loadPublishedWorkshopSummaries(): Promise<readonly WorkshopSummary[]> {\n96\t    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n97\t    if (supabase === null) {\n98\t        return [];\n99\t    }\n100\t\n101\t    const workshopRows = await findPublishedWorkshops(supabase);\n102\t    return workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow);\n103\t}\n104\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b7f2cd13-2785-4eb5-97ae-c4b928f3773c","uuid":"88c17951-a2ee-4d60-8516-c377f570fbaf","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:04:05.105Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\workshops\\workshopPublic.ts","content":"import { selectEventOccurrences, type EventOccurrence } from '@/lib/events/eventOccurrence';\nimport type { EventType } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\nimport {\n    findPublishedCommunity,\n    findPublishedWorkshops,\n    findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop,\n    findUpcomingPublishedWorkshops,\n    findWorkshopBySlug,\n    getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull,\n    mapWorkshopRow,\n    mapWorkshopSummaryRow,\n} from '@/lib/workshops/workshopDatabase';\nimport type { WorkshopDetails, WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n\n/**\n * Loads every term of one kind of event which visitors can still register for. A missing workshop database\n * deliberately looks like no listed terms instead of exposing internal configuration details on the public landing\n * page.\n */\nexport async function loadUpcomingPublishedEventSummaries(\n    eventType: EventType,\n): Promise<readonly EventOccurrence[]> {\n    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n    if (supabase === null) {\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    const workshopRows = await findUpcomingPublishedWorkshops(supabase, eventType);\n    return selectEventOccurrences(workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow));\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads every published term of one kind of event, including the ones which are running right now and the ones which\n * are already over. A missing workshop database deliberately looks like no listed terms, exactly as it does on the\n * public landing page of that event.\n *\n * Note: This is what a room offers a participant to choose from, so it deliberately says more than the landing page\n *       of the same event does. A term is worth entering while it runs and long after it ended, while only a term\n *       which has not started yet is worth registering for.\n */\nexport async function loadPublishedEventSummaries(eventType: EventType): Promise<readonly EventOccurrence[]> {\n    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n    if (supabase === null) {\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    const workshopRows = await findPublishedWorkshops(supabase, eventType);\n    return selectEventOccurrences(workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow));\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolves a published occurrence of one kind of event selected by the URL. Legacy links without a selection\n * deliberately enter the most recent published occurrence of that event, while an explicitly unknown slug never\n * silently opens a different workshop.\n */\nexport async function loadSelectedPublishedWorkshop(\n    requestedWorkshopSlug: string | null,\n    eventType: EventType,\n): Promise<WorkshopDetails | null> {\n    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n    if (supabase === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const workshopRow =\n        requestedWorkshopSlug === null\n            ? await findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop(supabase, eventType)\n            : await findWorkshopBySlug(supabase, requestedWorkshopSlug, true);\n\n    if (workshopRow === null || workshopRow.room_kind !== 'workshop' || workshopRow.event_type !== eventType) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    return mapWorkshopRow(workshopRow);\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the one published community room. Its data model is shared with workshops so participants get the same\n * secure live-room capabilities without a second copy of the session and moderation model.\n */\nexport async function loadPublishedCommunity(): Promise<WorkshopDetails | null> {\n    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n    if (supabase === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const communityRow = await findPublishedCommunity(supabase);\n    return communityRow === null ? null : mapWorkshopRow(communityRow);\n}\n\n/**\n * Lists every published term of every kind of event for the community, including past terms but never the community\n * room itself or unpublished drafts.\n */\nexport async function loadPublishedWorkshopSummaries(): Promise<readonly WorkshopSummary[]> {\n    const supabase = getWorkshopDatabaseOrNull();\n    if (supabase === null) {\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    const workshopRows = await findPublishedWorkshops(supabase);\n    return workshopRows.map(mapWorkshopSummaryRow);\n}\n","numLines":104,"startLine":1,"totalLines":104}}}

They are administered where they belong, in the administration of the community\n     *       which owns them, rather than being editable from two places at once.\n     */\n    readonly attachedPolls: readonly WorkshopAdminPoll[];\n    readonly comments: readonly WorkshopAdminComment[];\n\n    /**\n     * The message pinned on top of the chat, whatever moderation state the administration is listing\n     */\n    readonly pinnedComment: WorkshopCommentReference | null;\n\n    /**\n     * The question currently shown over the shared stage, if the room has one\n     */\n    readonly stageComment: WorkshopCommentReference | null;\n    readonly participants: readonly WorkshopAdminParticipant[];\n    readonly participantCount: number;\n    readonly commentCount: number;\n    readonly reactionCount: number;\n    readonly artificialReactionCount: number;\n};\n\nexport type WorkshopRealtimeEvent =\n    | { readonly kind: 'state-changed' }\n    | { readonly kind: 'reaction'; readonly reaction: WorkshopReaction; readonly reactionCount: number }\n    | { readonly kind: 'upvote'; readonly commentId: string; readonly upvoteCount: number }\n    | { readonly kind: 'stage-comment'; readonly stageComment: WorkshopCommentReference | null }\n    | { readonly kind: 'repository-commit'; readonly commit: GithubCommit };\n","numLines":603,"startLine":1,"totalLines":603}}}

        <span className=\"break-words font-semibold\">{workshop.title}</span>\n                        <WorkshopPhaseBadge phase={phase} tone=\"dark\" />\n                    </span>\n             {formatEventListingDateTime(workshop.startsAt, locale, timeZone)}\n                    </span>\n                    <span className=\"mt-1 block break-words text-xs font-normal The session of a project discussion is\n79\t     *       made out of the community session which opened it, so signing out there would be undone by the very next\n80\t     *       visit; a member of a project discussion signs out of the community instead.\n81\t     */\n82\t    readonly isDisconnectionOffered: boolean;\n83\t\n84\t    /**\n85\t     * Whether a room updates itself while it is open, which its broadcast, its reactions, and its watching count need\n86\t     */\n87\t    readonly isRealtime: boolean;\n88\t};\n89\t\n90\t/**\n91\t * Every room kind together with what it is\n92\t *\n93\t * Note: A workshop occurrence is the live event this infrastructure was built for. project: {\n130\t        isSingleton: false,\n131\t        isSlugFixed: true,\n132\t        isScheduled: false,\n133\t        isEvent: false,\n134\t        isStageOffered: false,\n135\t        isRepositoryOffered: false,\n136\t        isPresentationOffered: false,\n137\t        isPollsOffered: false,\n138\t        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n139\t        isMembershipOffered: WorkshopKindCapabilities = {\n    /**\n     * Whether exactly one room of this kind exists, so nothing offers a choice between rooms or the creation of another\n     */\n    readonly isSingleton: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether the URL of a room is decided once and for all, so its administration neither offers it nor lets an edit\n     * disconnect the links leading to it\n     */\n    readonly isSlugFixed: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room happens at a time, so it has a start, an end, and a countdown towards it\n     */\n    readonly isScheduled: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room is one term of a public event, so it says which kind of event it is, where it is held, what it\n     * costs, and how many people fit into it\n     */\n    readonly isEvent: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room gathers its participants around a shared stage with a video stream\n     */\n    readonly isStageOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room can be about a project, so its administration connects a repository to it and the room shows what\n     * is being built in that repository while the room runs\n     */\n    readonly isRepositoryOffered: boolean;\n\n    /** Whether a room can give every participant a presentation beside its ordinary materials. */\n    readonly isPresentationOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether the room offers member polls, which are currently the permanent community's way to make a decision\n     * together without turning an individual live workshop into a survey.\n     */\n    readonly isPollsOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether this room can show a community poll which is attached to it. A workshop occurrence is the subject of\n     * such a poll rather than its owner, so it shows and changes the one common e-mail-owned vote there.\n     */\n    readonly isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room says which membership of the community the connected member has, and lets them buy and manage it\n     * without leaving the room\n     *\n     * Note: The membership belongs to the address a member connects with rather than to one room, so every room which\n     *       offers it reads and changes the very same membership.\n     */\n    readonly isMembershipOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room leads its participants on into the permanent community, which is where everything outlasting one\n     * term is kept\n     *\n     * Note: The community never invites anybody into itself, and a project discussion is opened from the community\n     *       which already showed that project, so only a room a member can reach without the community offers the way\n     *       there.\n     */\n    readonly isCommunityInvitationOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a participant can end their own session in this room and be offered its connection form again, which\n     * they read as signing out of it\n     *\n     * Note: Only a room a participant connected to themselves is left this way. The session of a project discussion is\n     *       made out of the community session which opened it, so signing out there would be undone by the very next\n     *       visit; a member of a project discussion signs out of the community instead.\n     */\n    readonly isDisconnectionOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room updates itself while it is open, which its broadcast, its reactions, and its watching count need\n     */\n    readonly isRealtime: boolean;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every room kind together with what it is\n *\n * Note: A workshop occurrence is the live event this infrastructure was built for. The community reuses the very same\n *       secured room, but is one permanent, calm space rather than an occurrence which starts, streams, and ends.\n * Note: This is the one place a room kind is described. Every screen reads it, so a kind added later needs no change\n *       of the room, of its administration, or of the routes behind them.\n */\nconst WORKSHOP_KIND_CAPABILITY_DEFINITIONS: Readonly<Record<WorkshopKind, WorkshopKindCapabilities>> = {\n    workshop: {\n        isSingleton: false,\n        isSlugFixed: false,\n        isScheduled: true,\n        isEvent: true,\n        isStageOffered: true,\n        isRepositoryOffered: true,\n        isPresentationOffered: true,\n        isPollsOffered: false,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: true,\n        isMembershipOffered: true,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: true,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n        isRealtime: true,\n    },\n    community: {\n        isSingleton: true,\n        isSlugFixed: true,\n        isScheduled: false,\n        isEvent: false,\n        isStageOffered: false,\n        isRepositoryOffered: false,\n        isPresentationOffered: false,\n        isPollsOffered: true,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n        isMembershipOffered: true,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n        isRealtime: false,\n    },\n    project: {\n        isSingleton: false,\n        isSlugFixed: true,\n        isScheduled: false,\n        isEvent: false,\n        isStageOffered: false,\n        isRepositoryOffered: false,\n        isPresentationOffered: false,\n        isPollsOffered: false,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n        isMembershipOffered: false,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: false,\n        isRealtime: false,\n    },\n};\n\nexport function getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind: WorkshopKind): WorkshopKindCapabilities {\n    return WORKSHOP_KIND_CAPABILITY_DEFINITIONS[workshopKind];\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether a member room can show and vote on visible community polls. Community owns and administers them, while a\n * workshop occurrence can use the same vote only for polls the community attached to it.\n */\nexport function isWorkshopPollVisibleInRoom(workshopKind: WorkshopKind): boolean {\n    const { isPollsOffered, isAttachedCommunityPollsShown } = getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind);\n    return isPollsOffered || isAttachedCommunityPollsShown;\n}\n\n/**\n * The settings of a room which its kind does not have at all\n */\nconst WORKSHOP_SCHEDULE_FIELD_NAMES = ['startsAt', 'endsAt'] as const;\nconst WORKSHOP_STAGE_FIELD_NAMES = [\n    'youtubeVideoId',\n    'recordingStartOffsetSeconds',\n    'previewYoutubeVideoId',\n] as const;\nconst WORKSHOP_REPOSITORY_FIELD_NAMES = ['repository'] as const;\nconst WORKSHOP_PRESENTATION_FIELD_NAMES = ['presentationUrl'] as const;\nconst WORKSHOP_SLUG_FIELD_NAMES = ['slug'] as const;\nconst WORKSHOP_EVENT_FIELD_NAMES = [\n    'eventType',\n    'locationKind',\n    'locationLabel',\n    'priceCzk',\n    'maximumParticipantCount',\n] as const;\n\n/**\n * The written settings which the kind of a room does not have\n *\n * Note: The administration already leaves these settings out of its form, so this only refuses a stale or a forged\n *       request which would give a calm room a schedule, a stage, a presentation, or a project that nothing in it\n *       could ever show, or move the only room of its kind to an address every link to it would miss.\n */\nexport function getUnsupportedWorkshopKindFieldNames(\n    workshopKind: WorkshopKind,\n    values: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,\n): readonly string[] {\n    const capabilities = getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind);\n    const unsupportedFieldNames = [\n        ...(capabilities.isScheduled ? [] : WORKSHOP_SCHEDULE_FIELD_NAMES),\n        ...(capabilities.isEvent ? [] : WORKSHOP_EVENT_FIELD_NAMES),\n        ...(capabilities.isStageOffered ? [] : WORKSHOP_PRESENTATION_FIELD_NAMES),\n        ...(capabilities.isSlugFixed ? {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01MBQbFpny4iLMEbPH7xeXbB","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t-- Every public event term lives in `public.workshops`, whatever kind of event it is.\n2\t--\n3\t-- A room which happens at a time is an event: it has a kind of event it is, a\n4\t-- place or an online form, a price, and the number of people who fit into it.\n5\t-- A permanent room such as the community or a project discussion is not an\n6\t-- event at all, so it carries none of these fields.\n7\t--\n8\t-- The kind of event is deliberately only checked for its format rather than\n9\t-- against a list of known values. Offering another kind of event therefore\n10\t-- means describing it in the event registry of the application, not migrating\n11\t-- the database again.\n12\t\n13\tBEGIN;\n14\t\n15\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n16\t    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_type text,\n17\t    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location_kind text,\n18\t    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location_label text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n19\t    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS price_czk integer,\n20\t    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS maximum_participant_count integer;\n21\t\n22\t-- Every occurrence which already exists is a term of the free online workshop.\n23\tUPDATE public.workshops\n24\tSET event_type = COALESCE(event_type, 'online-workshop'),\n25\t    location_kind = COALESCE(location_kind, 'online'),\n26\t    price_czk = COALESCE(price_czk, 0)\n27\tWHERE room_kind = 'workshop';\n28\t\n29\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n30\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_event_type_format;\n31\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n32\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_event_type_format CHECK (\n33\t        event_type IS NULL OR event_type ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$'\n34\t    );\n35\t\n36\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n37\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_location_kind;\n38\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n39\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_location_kind CHECK (\n40\t        location_kind IS NULL OR location_kind IN ('online', 'onsite')\n41\t    );\n42\t\n43\t-- A term which is held somewhere says where, while an online term never does.\n44\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n45\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_location_label;\n46\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n47\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_location_label CHECK (\n48\t        char_length(location_label) <= 200\n49\t        AND (location_kind <> 'onsite' OR char_length(btrim(location_label)) > 0)\n50\t    );\n51\t\n52\t-- A price of zero is a free event, which is what the free online workshop is.\n53\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n54\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_price_czk;\n55\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n56\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_price_czk CHECK (price_czk IS NULL OR price_czk >= 0);\n57\t\n58\t-- No maximum at all is a term nobody can be turned away from.\n59\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n60\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_maximum_participant_count;\n61\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n62\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_maximum_participant_count CHECK (\n63\t        maximum_participant_count IS NULL OR maximum_participant_count > 0\n64\t    );\n65\t\n66\t-- An occurrence is an event and describes itself as one; a permanent room is not\n67\t-- an event and therefore describes nothing of the sort.\n68\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n69\t    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_event_fields;\n70\tALTER TABLE public.workshops\n71\t    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_event_fields CHECK (\n72\t        (room_kind = 'workshop') = (event_type IS NOT NULL)\n73\t        AND (event_type IS NULL) = (location_kind IS NULL)\n74\t        AND (event_type IS NULL) = (price_czk IS NULL)\n75\t        AND (event_type IS NOT NULL OR char_length(location_label) = 0)\n76\t        AND (event_type IS NOT NULL OR maximum_participant_count IS NULL)\n77\t    );\n78\t\n79\t-- The landing page of one kind of event lists its published terms in start order.\n80\tCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workshops_event_type_starts_at_idx\n81\t    ON public.workshops (event_type, starts_at ASC)\n82\t    WHERE is_published;\n83\t\n84\t-- The terms of the paid one-day workshop, which the application used to carry\n85\t-- hard-coded. Their identifiers stay the dates the registrations were written\n86\t-- with, so the seats already taken keep being counted against these very terms.\n87\tINSERT INTO public.workshops (\n88\t    slug,\n89\t    room_kind,\n90\t    event_type,\n91\t    title,\n92\t    description,\n93\t    starts_at,\n94\t    ends_at,\n95\t    location_kind,\n96\t    location_label,\n97\t    price_czk,\n98\t    maximum_participant_count,\n99\t    youtube_video_id,\n100\t    is_published\n101\t)\n102\tVALUES\n103\t    (\n104\t        'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-04',\n105\t        'workshop',\n106\t        'ai-supervize-mini',\n107\t        'AI Supervize Mini · Praha',\n108\t        'Celodenní prezenční workshop AI Supervize Mini pro vývojáře a produkťáky.',\n109\t        '2026-09-04T10:00:00+02:00',\n110\t        '2026-09-04T16:00:00+02:00',\n111\t        'onsite',\n112\t        'Praha',\n113\t        12000,\n114\t        10,\n115\t        NULL,\n116\t        true\n117\t    ),\n118\t    (\n119\t        'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-09',\n120\t        'workshop',\n121\t        'ai-supervize-mini',\n122\t        'AI Supervize Mini · online',\n123\t        'Odpolední online varianta workshopu AI Supervize Mini.',\n124\t        '2026-09-09T13:00:00+02:00',\n125\t        '2026-09-09T17:00:00+02:00',\n126\t        'online',\n127\t        '',\n128\t event is deliberately only checked for its format rather than\n-- against a list of known values. Offering another kind of event therefore\n-- means describing it in the event registry of the application, not migrating\n-- the database again.\n\nBEGIN;\n\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS event_type text,\n    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location_kind text,\n    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS location_label text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS price_czk integer,\n    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS maximum_participant_count integer;\n\n-- Every occurrence which already exists is a term of the free online workshop.\nUPDATE public.workshops\nSET event_type = COALESCE(event_type, 'online-workshop'),\n    location_kind = COALESCE(location_kind, 'online'),\n    price_czk = COALESCE(price_czk, 0)\nWHERE room_kind = 'workshop';\n\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_event_type_format;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_event_type_format CHECK (\n        event_type IS NULL OR event_type ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$'\n    );\n\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_location_kind;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_location_kind CHECK (\n        location_kind IS NULL OR location_kind IN ('online', 'onsite')\n    );\n\n-- A term which is held somewhere says where, while an online term never does.\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_location_label;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_location_label CHECK (\n        char_length(location_label) <= 200\n        AND (location_kind <> 'onsite' OR char_length(btrim(location_label)) > 0)\n    );\n\n-- A price of zero is a free event, which is what the free online workshop is.\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_price_czk;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_price_czk CHECK (price_czk IS NULL OR price_czk >= 0);\n\n-- No maximum at all is a term nobody can be turned away from.\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_maximum_participant_count;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_maximum_participant_count CHECK (\n        maximum_participant_count IS NULL OR maximum_participant_count > 0\n    );\n\n-- An occurrence is an event and describes itself as one; a permanent room is not\n-- an event and therefore describes nothing of the sort.\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS workshops_event_fields;\nALTER TABLE public.workshops\n    ADD CONSTRAINT workshops_event_fields CHECK (\n        (room_kind = 'workshop') = (event_type IS NOT NULL)\n        AND (event_type IS NULL) = (location_kind IS NULL)\n        AND (event_type IS NULL) = (price_czk IS NULL)\n        AND (event_type IS NOT NULL OR char_length(location_label) = 0)\n        AND (event_type IS NOT NULL OR maximum_participant_count IS NULL)\n    );\n\n-- The landing page of one kind of event lists its published terms in start order.\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS workshops_event_type_starts_at_idx\n    ON public.workshops (event_type, starts_at ASC)\n    WHERE is_published;\n\n-- The terms of the paid one-day workshop, which the application used to carry\n-- hard-coded. Their identifiers stay the dates the registrations were written\n-- with, so the seats already taken keep being counted against these very terms.\nINSERT INTO public.workshops (\n    slug,\n    room_kind,\n    event_type,\n    title,\n    description,\n    starts_at,\n    ends_at,\n    location_kind,\n    location_label,\n    price_czk,\n    maximum_participant_count,\n    youtube_video_id,\n    is_published\n)\nVALUES\n    (\n        'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-04',\n        'workshop',\n        'ai-supervize-mini',\n        'AI Supervize Mini · Praha',\n        'Celodenní prezenční workshop AI Supervize Mini pro vývojáře a produkťáky.',\n        '2026-09-04T10:00:00+02:00',\n        '2026-09-04T16:00:00+02:00',\n        'onsite',\n        'Praha',\n        12000,\n        10,\n        NULL,\n        true\n    ),\n    (\n        'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-09',\n        'workshop',\n        'ai-supervize-mini',\n        'AI Supervize Mini · online',\n        'Odpolední online varianta workshopu AI Supervize Mini.',\n        '2026-09-09T13:00:00+02:00',\n        '2026-09-09T17:00:00+02:00',\n        'online',\n        '',\n        3000,\n        50,\n        NULL,\n        true\n    ),\n    (\n        'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-18',\n        'workshop',\n        'ai-supervize-mini',\n        'AI Supervize Mini · online',\n        'Odpolední online varianta workshopu AI Supervize Mini.',\n        '2026-09-18T13:00:00+02:00',\n        '2026-09-18T17:00:00+02:00',\n        'online',\n        '',\n        3000,\n        50,\n        NULL,\n        true\n    )\nON CONFLICT (slug) DO NOTHING;\n\nCOMMIT;\n","numLines":151,"startLine":1,"totalLines":151}}}

isEventLocationKind,\n} from '@/lib/events/eventLocation';\nimport { formatEventPrice } from '@/lib/events/eventPrice';\nimport { EVENT_TYPE_DEFINITION_LIST, isEventType } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\n\ntype WorkshopEventFieldsProps = {\n    readonly event: EventDetails;\n    readonly onChange: (event: EventDetails) => void;\n};\n\nconst ADMIN_SELECT_CLASS_NAME =\n    'mt-2 h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-200';\n\nfunction readOptionalCount(value: string): number | null {\n    const count = Number.parseInt(value, 10);\n    return Number.isSafeInteger(count) && count > 0 ? count : null;\n}\n\nfunction readPriceCzk(value: string): number {\n    const priceCzk = Number.parseInt(value, 10);\n    return Number.isSafeInteger(priceCzk) && priceCzk > 0 ? priceCzk : 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * What one term says about the event it is a term of, wherever an administrator writes it\n *\n * Note: Creating a term and editing one ask exactly the same questions, so an event never means one thing in one form\n *       and something else in the other.\n */\nexport function WorkshopEventFields({ event, onChange }: WorkshopEventFieldsProps) {\n    return (\n        <>\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Typ akce\n                <select\n                    value={event.type}\n                    onChange={(changeEvent) => {\n                        const eventType = changeEvent.target.value;\n                        if (isEventType(eventType)) {\n                            onChange({ ...event, type: eventType });\n                        }\n                    }}\n                    className={ADMIN_SELECT_CLASS_NAME}\n                >\n                    {EVENT_TYPE_DEFINITION_LIST.map((eventTypeDefinition) => (\n                        <option key={eventTypeDefinition.id} value={eventTypeDefinition.id}>\n                            {eventTypeDefinition.label}\n                        </option>\n                    ))}\n                </select>\n                <span className=\"mt-1 block text-xs font-normal text-slate-400\">\n                    Termín se vypíše na landing page tohoto typu akce.\n                </span>\n            </label>\n\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Místo konání\n                <select\n                    value={event.locationKind}\n                    onChange={(changeEvent) => {\n                        const locationKind = changeEvent.target.value;\n                        if (isEventLocationKind(locationKind)) {\n                            onChange({\n                                ...event,\n                                locationKind,\n                                locationLabel: locationKind === 'online' ? '' : event.locationLabel,\n                            });\n                        }\n                    }}\n                    className={ADMIN_SELECT_CLASS_NAME}\n                >\n                    {EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_VALUES.map((locationKind) => (\n                        <option key={locationKind} value={locationKind}>\n                            {EVENT_LOCATION_KIND_LABELS[locationKind]}\n                        </option>\n                    ))}\n                </select>\n            </label>\n\n            {event.locationKind === 'onsite' && (\n                <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                    Místo\n                    <Input\n                        value={event.locationLabel}\n                        onChange={(changeEvent) => onChange({ ...event, locationLabel: changeEvent.target.value })}\n                        className=\"mt-2\"\n                        placeholder=\"Praha\"\n                        required\n                    />\n                </label>\n            )}\n\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Cena za účastníka (Kč)\n                <Input\n                    type=\"number\"\n                    min={0}\n                    value={event.priceCzk}\n                    onChange={(changeEvent) =>\n                        onChange({ ...event, priceCzk: readPriceCzk(changeEvent.target.value) })\n                    }\n                    className=\"mt-2\"\n                />\n                <span className=\"mt-1 block text-xs font-normal text-slate-400\">\n                    Nula znamená akci zdarma, teď: {formatEventPrice(event.priceCzk)}.\n                </span>\n            </label>\n\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Maximální počet účastníků\n                <Input\n                    type=\"number\"\n                    min={1}\n                    value={event.maximumParticipantCount ?? ''}\n                    onChange={(changeEvent) =>\n                        onChange({\n                            ...event,\n                            maximumParticipantCount: readOptionalCount(changeEvent.target.value),\n                        })\n                    }\n                    className=\"mt-2\"\n                    placeholder=\"Bez omezení\"\n                />\n            </label>\n        </>\n    );\n}\n","numLines":135,"startLine":1,"totalLines":135}}}

 * The administered term, which says which event it is a term of and whether it is published at all\n     */\n    readonly workshop: WorkshopSummary;\n};\n\nconst UNPUBLISHED_EVENT_NOTE =\n    'Termín zatím není publikovaný, takže návštěvníka pustí jen výběr publikovaných termínů.';\n\n/**\n * Opens the very event which is being administered, so that whoever manages a term also reads it as a terms in the community lead to, rather than an address\n *       written a second time here. A permanent room which is no term of an event has no such page and offers no link.\n */\nexport function WorkshopEventLinks({ workshop }: WorkshopEventLinksProps) {\n    const eventLink = items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-950\">\n                        <Globe className=\"h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-cyan-600\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> {eventTypeLabel} na webu\n                    </h2>\n                    <p className=\"mt-1 break-all font-mono text-xs text-slate-500\">{eventLink}</p>\n                    {!workshop.isPublished && <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs text-amber-600\">{UNPUBLISHED_EVENT_NOTE}</p>}\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2\">\n                    <Button asChild size=\"sm\">\n                        <a href={eventLink} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">\n                            <ExternalLink className=\"mr-1.5 h-4 w-4\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Otevřít akci\n                        </a>\n                    </Button>\n                    {isLandingPageSeparate && (\n                        <Button asChild variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\">\n                            <a href={landingPagePath} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">\n                                <ExternalLink className=\"mr-1.5 h-4 w-4\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Landing page akce\n                            </a>\n                        </Button>\n                    )}\n                </div>\n            </div>\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n","numLines":66,"startLine":1,"totalLines":66}}}

deployment can never outlive the repository it belongs to.\n     */\n    readonly repository?: WorkshopRepositoryWriteValues | null;\n    readonly allowedReactions?: readonly string[];\n};\n\n/**\n * string;\n};\n\n/**\n * The event of one term as its administration writes it\n *\n * Note: The form of the administration edits the very same shape every page reads, so a field added to an event is\n *       written, stored, and listed without a second description of it anywhere.\n */\nexport function createWorkshopEventWriteValues(event: EventDetails) {\n    return {\n        eventType: event.type,\n        locationKind: event.locationKind,\n        locationLabel: event.locationLabel,\n        priceCzk: event.priceCzk,\n        maximumParticipantCount: emoji: string;\n};\n\nfunction createAdminApiUrl(\n    path: string,\n    additionalParameters: Readonly<Record<string, string | undefined>> = {},\n): string {\n    return );\n}\n\nexport async function fetchAdminWorkshopParticipantPage(\n    workshopId: string,\n    query: WorkshopAdminParticipantQuery,\n): Promise<WorkshopAdminParticipantPage> {\n    const createAdminApiUrl(`/${encodeURIComponent(workshopId)}/feedback`),\n    );\n    return result.feedbacks;\n}\n\n/**\n * Builds a download URL for one workshop administration section.\n */\nexport exportParameters.page;\n    delete exportParameters.pageSize;\n\n    return createAdminApiUrl(\n        `/${encodeURIComponent(workshopId)}/exports/${encodeURIComponent(exportKind)}`,\n        exportParameters,\n    );\n}\n\nexport async function createAdminWorkshop(values: WorkshopCreateValues): Promise<WorkshopDetails> {\n    const result = await requestAdminJson<{ readonly workshop: WorkshopDetails }>(\n        createAdminApiUrl(''),\n        createJsonMutation('POST', values),\n    );\n    return result.workshop;\n}\n\nexport async function updateAdminWorkshop(workshopId: createAdminApiUrl(`/${encodeURIComponent(workshopId)}`),\n        createJsonMutation('PATCH', values),\n    );\n    return result.workshop;\n}\n\n/**\n * Soft-deletes one event occurrence. WorkshopContentWriteValues,\n): Promise<WorkshopContentBlock> {\n    const result = await requestAdminJson<{ readonly contentBlock: WorkshopContentBlock }>(\n        createAdminApiUrl(`/${encodeURIComponent(workshopId)}/content`),\n        createJsonMutation('POST', values),\n    );\n    return result.contentBlock;\n}\n\nexport async function createAdminApiUrl(`/${encodeURIComponent(workshopId)}/content/${encodeURIComponent(contentId)}`),\n        { method: 'DELETE' },\n    );\n}\n\nexport async function createAdminWorkshopPoll(workshopId:
