{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cf6waDZtr1PFu5SVGrnMb","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01V25uWLXhssRm9g4BVmuf6s","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\events\\eventLinks.ts","old_string":" * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the\n *       room never asks for it again. A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n *       different kind of event.\n */\nexport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n): string | null {\n    if (workshop.event === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n\n    return participantPath === null\n        ? landingPagePath\n        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n}","new_string":" * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the\n *       room never asks for it again. A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n * Note: A term of an event held by somebody else leads to the address it is held at, because that is the only place\n *       there is to read about it and to sign up for it. A term which was never given one leads nowhere rather than to\n *       a page which knows nothing about it.\n * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n *       different kind of event.\n */\nexport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n): string | null {\n    if (workshop.event === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n\n    if (landingPagePath === null) {\n        return workshop.event.externalUrl;\n    }\n\n    return participantPath === null\n        ? landingPagePath\n        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n}"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":335,"cache_read_input_tokens":204936,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":335},"output_tokens":20,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b7f2cd13-2785-4eb5-97ae-c4b928f3773c","uuid":"8697994c-4473-4394-b516-23c21eddc482","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:14:02.197Z","request_id":"req_011Cf6waD4styyxoV1LkFbMw"}

A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n * Note: A term of an event held by somebody else leads to the address it is held at, because that is the only place\n *       there is to read about it and to sign up for it. A term which was never given one leads nowhere rather than to\n *       a page which knows nothing about it.\n * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n *       different kind of event.\n */\nexport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n): string | null {\n    if (workshop.event === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n\n    if (landingPagePath === null) {\n        return workshop.event.externalUrl;\n    }\n\n    return participantPath === null\n        ? landingPagePath\n        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n}","originalFile":"import { getEventTypeDefinition, isExternalEventType } from '@/lib/events/eventTypes';\nimport { createWorkshopRoomLink, type WorkshopParticipantIdentity } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopParticipantLink';\nimport type { WorkshopSummary } from '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n\n/**\n * Nobody in particular, which is who a publicly published link is built for\n */\nconst ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY: WorkshopParticipantIdentity = { email: '', fullname: '' };\n\n/**\n * Where one term of an event leads a member who is already connected somewhere else\n *\n * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the\n *       room never asks for it again. A kind of event without a room leads to its landing page, where a visitor picks\n *       a term and registers for it, because there is nothing else to open.\n * Note: A room which is not a term of any event the application knows leads nowhere rather than into the room of a\n *       different kind of event.\n */\nexport function createEventLinkOrNull(\n    workshop: WorkshopSummary,\n    participantIdentity: WorkshopParticipantIdentity,\n): string | null {\n    if (workshop.event === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    const { participantPath, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n\n    return participantPath === null\n        ? landingPagePath\n        : createWorkshopRoomLink(participantPath, participantIdentity, workshop.slug);\n}\n\n/**\n * Where one term leads everybody, which is the same destination without the identity of any member\n *\n * Note: This is what a published calendar carries, because such a calendar is read by whoever subscribed to it and by\n *       every calendar application on the way. It never names the member it was downloaded by.\n */\nexport function createPublicEventLinkOrNull(workshop: WorkshopSummary): string | null {\n    return createEventLinkOrNull(workshop, ANONYMOUS_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY);\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":6,"newStart":13,"newLines":9,"lines":["  * Note: A kind of event with a live room leads into that room and carries the already verified identity there, so the","  *       room never asks for it again. (materializedContentResult) => materializedContentResult.errorMessage !== null,\n    )?.errorMessage;\n    if (materializationErrorMessage !== null && materializationErrorMessage !== undefined) {\n        return { state: null, errorMessage: materializationErrorMessage };\n    }\n    const materializedContentBlocks = materializedContentResults.map((materializedContentResult) => ({\n        ...materializedContentResult.contentBlock,\n        bodyMarkdown: materializedContentResult.bodyMarkdown ?? materializedContentResult.contentBlock.bodyMarkdown,\n    }));\n\n    const commentRows = []).map(({ comment_id }) => comment_id as string));\n    }\n\n    const authorByParticipantId = await loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows);\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered,\n    };\n    const materializedCommentResults = await Promise.all(\n        commentRows.map(async (commentRow) => {\n            const author =\n                commentRow.participant_id === null ? undefined : authorByParticipantId.get(commentRow.participant_id);\n            if (\n                !areWorkshopCommentLinksEnabled({\n                    isArtificial: commentRow.is_artificial,\n                    isAuthorModerator: author?.isModerator ?? []) as WorkshopReactionRow[]).map(mapWorkshopReactionRow),\n            reactionCounts: reactionCountsResult.reactionCounts,\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the comments answered by the listed ones, so moderation of a reply sees the question it answers\n *\n * Note: The listed comments are filtered by one moderation status, so an answered comment is almost never among them.\n * Note: Missing context must never take the whole administration down with it, so a failure is reported as no context.\n */\nasync function loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    commentRows: readonly WorkshopCommentRow[],\n): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorkshopCommentReference>> {\n    const answeredCommentIds = Array.from(\n        new Set(\n            commentRows\n                .map((commentRow) => commentRow.parent_comment_id)\n                .filter((parentCommentId): parentCommentId is string => parentCommentId !== null),\n        ),\n    );\n    if (answeredCommentIds.length === 0) {\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_REFERENCE_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId)\n        .in('id', answeredCommentIds);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the answered comments of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    return new Map(\n        ((data ?? attachedPollsResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n    if (stageCommentResult.errorMessage !== null) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: stageCommentResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    const commentRows = (commentsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopCommentRow[];\n    const [answeredCommentById, authorByParticipantId] = await Promise.all([\n        loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n        loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n    ]);\n\n    // Note: The administration moderates every room, so it reads the authors of the listed messages as they are.\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered: true,\n    };\n    const comments = commentRows.map((row): WorkshopAdminComment => ({\n        ...mapWorkshopCommentRow(row, false, roomContext),\n        participantId: row.participant_id,\n        isArtificial: row.is_artificial,\n        realUpvoteCount: row.upvote_count,\n        artificialUpvoteCount: row.artificial_upvote_count,\n        parentComment: row.parent_comment_id === null ? null : (answeredCommentById.get(row.parent_comment_id) ?? null),\n    }));\n    const linkClickCountByContentBlockId = new Map<string, number>(\n        ((contentLinkClickTotalsResult.data ?? secondContentBlock.sort_order ||\n                Date.parse(firstContentBlock.unlock_at) - Date.parse(secondContentBlock.unlock_at),\n        )\n        .map(mapWorkshopContentRow);\n    // Only what published for it instead of the stream, rather than the room merely not playing what it\n    // still handed over.\n    const { readableVideo, paidMembersOnlyVideo } = contentBlock.id,\n                bodyMarkdown: contentBlock.bodyMarkdown,\n            })),\n        })),\n    );\n    const materializationErrorMessage = materializedContentResults.find(\n        (materializedContentResult) => materializedContentResult.errorMessage !== null,\n    )?.errorMessage;\n    if (materializationErrorMessage !== null && materializationErrorMessage !== undefined) {\n        return { state: null, errorMessage: materializationErrorMessage };\n    }\n    const materializedContentBlocks = materializedContentResults.map((materializedContentResult) => ({\n        ...materializedContentResult.contentBlock,\n        bodyMarkdown: materializedContentResult.bodyMarkdown ?? materializedContentResult.contentBlock.bodyMarkdown,\n    }));\n\n    const commentRows = withPinnedWorkshopCommentRow(\n        [\n            ...((commentsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopCommentRow[]),\n            ...((pendingCommentsResult.data ?? []).map(({ comment_id }) => comment_id as string));\n    }\n\n    const authorByParticipantId = await loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows);\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered,\n    };\n    const materializedCommentResults = await Promise.all(\n        commentRows.map(async (commentRow) => {\n            const author =\n                commentRow.participant_id === null ? undefined : authorByParticipantId.get(commentRow.participant_id);\n            if (\n                !areWorkshopCommentLinksEnabled({\n                    isArtificial: commentRow.is_artificial,\n                    isAuthorModerator: author?.isModerator ?? false,\n                })\n            ) {\n                return { commentRow, bodyMarkdown: commentRow.body, errorMessage: null };\n            }\n\n            return {\n                commentRow,\n                ...(await materializeWorkshopCommentShortLinks(supabase, {\n                    workshopSlug: workshopRow.slug,\n                    workshopKind: workshopRow.room_kind,\n                    commentId: commentRow.id,\n                    bodyMarkdown: commentRow.body,\n                })),\n            };\n        }),\n    );\n    const commentMaterializationErrorMessage = materializedCommentResults.find(\n        (materializedCommentResult) => materializedCommentResult.errorMessage !== null,\n    )?.errorMessage;\n    if (commentMaterializationErrorMessage !== null && commentMaterializationErrorMessage !== undefined) {\n        return { state: null, errorMessage: commentMaterializationErrorMessage };\n    }\n    const materializedCommentRows = materializedCommentResults.map((materializedCommentResult) => ({\n        ...materializedCommentResult.commentRow,\n        body: materializedCommentResult.bodyMarkdown ?? []) as WorkshopReactionRow[]).map(mapWorkshopReactionRow),\n            reactionCounts: reactionCountsResult.reactionCounts,\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the comments answered by the listed ones, so moderation of a reply sees the question it answers\n *\n * Note: The listed comments are filtered by one moderation status, so an answered comment is almost never among them.\n * Note: Missing context must never take the whole administration down with it, so a failure is reported as no context.\n */\nasync function loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    commentRows: readonly WorkshopCommentRow[],\n): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorkshopCommentReference>> {\n    const answeredCommentIds = Array.from(\n        new Set(\n            commentRows\n                .map((commentRow) => commentRow.parent_comment_id)\n                .filter((parentCommentId): parentCommentId is string => parentCommentId !== null),\n        ),\n    );\n    if (answeredCommentIds.length === 0) {\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_REFERENCE_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId)\n        .in('id', answeredCommentIds);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the answered comments of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    return new Map(\n        ((data ?? A room\n *       which lasts for days is measured more coarsely, so that the answer stays small however long it has been open.\n */\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): number {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const currentMilliseconds = Date.now();\n    const configuredEndsAtMilliseconds =\n        workshopRow.ends_at === null ? currentMilliseconds : Date.parse(workshopRow.ends_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = Math.max(startsAtMilliseconds, configuredEndsAtMilliseconds);\n    const durationMilliseconds = endsAtMilliseconds - startsAtMilliseconds;\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 2 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 60;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 8 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 300;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 900;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 3_600;\n    }\n\n    return 86_400;\n}\n\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineEndsAt(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): string {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = workshopRow.ends_at === null ? []) as WorkshopSummaryRow[];\n}\n\n/**\n * Resolves legacy public URLs which did not name an occurrence to the term of that very event with the newest start\n * date, so a link of one event never opens a term of another one.\n */\nexport async function findMostRecentPublishedWorkshop(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    eventType: EventType,\n): Promise<WorkshopRow | null> {\n    const { data, error } = await loadWorkshopQueryWithActiveStatus(supabase, (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) => {\n            let workshopQuery = supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n                .select('*')\n                .eq('room_kind', 'workshop')\n                .eq('event_type', eventType)\n                .eq('is_published', true)\n                .order('starts_at', { ascending: false })\n                .limit(1);\n\n            if (isActiveStatusFilterEnabled) {\n                workshopQuery = workshopQuery.eq(WORKSHOP_IS_DELETED_COLUMN_NAME, false);\n            }\n\n            return workshopQuery.maybeSingle();\n    });\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the most recent workshop:', error.message);\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    return data as WorkshopRow | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Lists every published term for the persistent community room, or every published term of one kind of event when a\n * kind is named. Every state reload and every heartbeat of every\n *       participant would otherwise count the whole audience for nobody to read.\n * Note: An unavailable count must never take the whole room down with it, so a failure is reported as nobody watching.\n */\nexport async function countWatchingWorkshopParticipants(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<number> {\n    if (!isWorkshopPanelOffered(workshopRow.room_kind, workshopRow.disabled_panels, 'watching-count')) {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    const watchingSince = new Date(Date.now() - WORKSHOP_WATCHING_WINDOW_SECONDS * 1_000).toISOString();\n    const { count, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .gte('last_seen_at', watchingSince);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to count the participants watching a workshop:', error.message);\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    return (count ?? 0) + Math.max(0, workshopRow.artificial_watching_participant_count ?? 0);\n}\n\ntype LoadedWorkshopReactionCounts = {\n    readonly reactionCounts: readonly WorkshopReactionCount[];\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n};\n\n/**\n * Loads the totals shown beside the reactions which a room currently offers\n *\n * Note: When the reactions panel is hidden, nobody can read these totals. undefined : authorByParticipantId.get(commentRow.participant_id);\n            if (\n                !areWorkshopCommentLinksEnabled({\n                    isArtificial: commentRow.is_artificial,\n                    isAuthorModerator: author?.isModerator ?? false,\n                })\n            ) {\n                return { commentRow, bodyMarkdown: commentRow.body, errorMessage: null };\n            }\n\n            return {\n                commentRow,\n                ...(await materializeWorkshopCommentShortLinks(supabase, {\n                    workshopSlug: workshopRow.slug,\n                    workshopKind: workshopRow.room_kind,\n                    commentId: commentRow.id,\n                    bodyMarkdown: commentRow.body,\n                })),\n            };\n        }),\n    );\n    const commentMaterializationErrorMessage = materializedCommentResults.find(\n        (materializedCommentResult) => materializedCommentResult.errorMessage !== null,\n    )?.errorMessage;\n    if (commentMaterializationErrorMessage !== null && commentMaterializationErrorMessage !== undefined) {\n        return { state: null, errorMessage: commentMaterializationErrorMessage };\n    }\n    const materializedCommentRows = materializedCommentResults.map((materializedCommentResult) => ({\n        ...materializedCommentResult.commentRow,\n        body: materializedCommentResult.bodyMarkdown ?? materializedCommentResult.commentRow.body,\n    }));\n\n    return {\n        state: {\n            serverTime: new Date().toISOString(),\n            workshop: { ...workshop, ...readableVideo },\n            participant,\n            watchingParticipantCount,\n            contentBlocks: materializedContentBlocks,\n            nextContentUnlockAt: (nextUnlockResult.data?.unlock_at as string | undefined) ?? null,\n            paidMembersOnlyContentPreviews,\n            paidMembersOnlyVideo,\n            feedback:\n                feedbackResult.data === null\n                    ? null\n                    : mapWorkshopFeedbackRow(feedbackResult.data as WorkshopFeedbackRow),\n            comments: sortWorkshopComments(\n                materializedCommentRows.map((row) =>\n                    mapWorkshopCommentRow(row, upvotedCommentIds.has(row.id), roomContext),\n                ),\n                commentSort,\n            ),\n            stageComment: stageCommentResult.comment,\n            recentReactions: ((reactionsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopReactionRow[]).map(mapWorkshopReactionRow),\n            reactionCounts: reactionCountsResult.reactionCounts,\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the comments answered by the listed ones, so moderation of a reply sees the question it answers\n *\n * Note: The listed comments are filtered by one moderation status, so an answered comment is almost never among them.\n * Note: Missing context must never take the whole administration down with it, so a failure is reported as no context.\n */\nasync function loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    commentRows: readonly WorkshopCommentRow[],\n): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorkshopCommentReference>> {\n    const answeredCommentIds = Array.from(\n        new Set(\n            commentRows\n                .map((commentRow) => commentRow.parent_comment_id)\n                .filter((parentCommentId): parentCommentId is string => parentCommentId !== null),\n        ),\n    );\n    if (answeredCommentIds.length === 0) {\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_REFERENCE_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId)\n        .in('id', answeredCommentIds);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the answered comments of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    return new Map(\n        ((data ?? []) as readonly WorkshopCommentReferenceRow[]).map(\n            (commentRow) => [commentRow.id, mapWorkshopCommentReferenceRow(commentRow)] as const,\n        ),\n    );\n}\n\ntype WorkshopAdminSnapshotOptions = {\n    /**\n     * Whether the currently opened administration section needs the list of moderated comments.\n     */\n    readonly isCommentsIncluded: boolean;\n};\n\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminSnapshot(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    commentStatus: WorkshopCommentStatus,\n    options: WorkshopAdminSnapshotOptions = { isCommentsIncluded: true },\n): Promise<{ readonly snapshot: WorkshopAdminSnapshot | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const [\n        contentResult,\n        commentsResult,\n        commentsCountResult,\n        participantCountResult,\n        contentLinkClickTotalsResult,\n        reactionsResult,\n        artificialReactionsResult,\n        pinnedCommentRow,\n        stageCommentResult,\n        pollsResult,\n        attachedPollsResult,\n    ] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_CONTENT_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select(WORKSHOP_CONTENT_COLUMNS)\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n            .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })\n            .order('unlock_at', { ascending: true }),\n        options.isCommentsIncluded\n            ? supabase\n                  .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n                  .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_COLUMNS)\n                  .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n                  .eq('status', commentStatus)\n                  .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n                  .limit(MAXIMAL_ADMIN_COMMENT_LIST_COUNT)\n            : Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }),\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id),\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_content_link_click_totals', { target_workshop_id: workshopRow.id }),\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_REACTION_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id),\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_REACTION_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n            .eq('is_artificial', true),\n        options.isCommentsIncluded ? loadPinnedWorkshopCommentRowOrNull(supabase, workshopRow) : Promise.resolve(null),\n        getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopRow.room_kind).isStageOffered && workshopRow.stage_comment_id !== null\n            ? loadWorkshopCommentReference(supabase, workshopRow.id, workshopRow.stage_comment_id)\n            : Promise.resolve({ comment: null, errorMessage: null }),\n        loadWorkshopAdminPolls(supabase, workshopRow),\n        loadWorkshopAttachedAdminPolls(supabase, workshopRow),\n    ]);\n\n    const firstError =\n        contentResult.error ??\n        commentsResult.error ??\n        commentsCountResult.error ??\n        participantCountResult.error ??\n        contentLinkClickTotalsResult.error ??\n        reactionsResult.error ??\n        artificialReactionsResult.error;\n    if (firstError) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: firstError.message };\n    }\n    if (pollsResult.errorMessage !== null || attachedPollsResult.errorMessage !== null) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: pollsResult.errorMessage ?? attachedPollsResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n    if (stageCommentResult.errorMessage !== null) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: stageCommentResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    const commentRows = (commentsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopCommentRow[];\n    const [answeredCommentById, authorByParticipantId] = await Promise.all([\n        loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n        loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n    ]);\n\n    // Note: The administration moderates every room, so it reads the authors of the listed messages as they are.\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered: true,\n    };\n    const comments = commentRows.map((row): WorkshopAdminComment => ({\n        ...mapWorkshopCommentRow(row, false, roomContext),\n        participantId: row.participant_id,\n        isArtificial: row.is_artificial,\n        realUpvoteCount: row.upvote_count,\n        artificialUpvoteCount: row.artificial_upvote_count,\n        parentComment: row.parent_comment_id === null ? null : (answeredCommentById.get(row.parent_comment_id) ?? null),\n    }));\n    const linkClickCountByContentBlockId = new Map<string, number>(\n        ((contentLinkClickTotalsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopContentLinkClickTotalsRow[]).map(\n            (linkClickTotals) =>\n                [\n                    linkClickTotals.content_block_id,\n                    getNonNegativeWholeNumber(linkClickTotals.link_click_count),\n                ] as const,\n        ),\n    );\n\n    return {\n        snapshot: {\n            workshop: mapWorkshopRow(workshopRow),\n            contentBlocks: ((contentResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopContentRow[]).map((contentBlock) =>\n                mapWorkshopContentRow(contentBlock, linkClickCountByContentBlockId.get(contentBlock.id) ?? 0),\n            ),\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n            attachedPolls: attachedPollsResult.polls,\n            comments,\n            pinnedComment: pinnedCommentRow === null ? null : mapWorkshopCommentReferenceRow(pinnedCommentRow),\n            stageComment: stageCommentResult.comment,\n            participants: [],\n            participantCount: participantCountResult.count ?? 0,\n            commentCount: commentsCountResult.count ?? 0,\n            reactionCount: reactionsResult.count ?? 0,\n            artificialReactionCount: artificialReactionsResult.count ?? 0,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":490,"oldLines":6,"newStart":490,"newLines":7,"lines":["             locationLabel: row.location_label,","             priceCzk: row.price_czk,","             maximumParticipantCount: row.maximum_participant_count,","+            externalUrl: row.external_url ?? null,","         }),","     };"," }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

A room\n *       which lasts for days is measured more coarsely, so that the answer stays small however long it has been open.\n */\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): number {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const currentMilliseconds = Date.now();\n    const configuredEndsAtMilliseconds =\n        workshopRow.ends_at === null ? currentMilliseconds : Date.parse(workshopRow.ends_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = Math.max(startsAtMilliseconds, configuredEndsAtMilliseconds);\n    const durationMilliseconds = endsAtMilliseconds - startsAtMilliseconds;\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 2 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 60;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 8 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 300;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 900;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 3_600;\n    }\n\n    return 86_400;\n}\n\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineEndsAt(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): string {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = workshopRow.ends_at === null ? Every state reload and every heartbeat of every\n *       participant would otherwise count the whole audience for nobody to read.\n * Note: An unavailable count must never take the whole room down with it, so a failure is reported as nobody watching.\n */\nexport async function countWatchingWorkshopParticipants(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<number> {\n    if (!isWorkshopPanelOffered(workshopRow.room_kind, workshopRow.disabled_panels, 'watching-count')) {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    const watchingSince = new Date(Date.now() - WORKSHOP_WATCHING_WINDOW_SECONDS * 1_000).toISOString();\n    const { count, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .gte('last_seen_at', watchingSince);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to count the participants watching a workshop:', error.message);\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    return (count ?? 0) + Math.max(0, workshopRow.artificial_watching_participant_count ?? 0);\n}\n\ntype LoadedWorkshopReactionCounts = {\n    readonly reactionCounts: readonly WorkshopReactionCount[];\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n};\n\n/**\n * Loads the totals shown beside the reactions which a room currently offers\n *\n * Note: When the reactions panel is hidden, nobody can read these totals. undefined : authorByParticipantId.get(commentRow.participant_id);\n            if (\n                !areWorkshopCommentLinksEnabled({\n                    isArtificial: commentRow.is_artificial,\n                    isAuthorModerator: author?.isModerator ?? []) as WorkshopReactionRow[]).map(mapWorkshopReactionRow),\n            reactionCounts: reactionCountsResult.reactionCounts,\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the comments answered by the listed ones, so moderation of a reply sees the question it answers\n *\n * Note: The listed comments are filtered by one moderation status, so an answered comment is almost never among them.\n * Note: Missing context must never take the whole administration down with it, so a failure is reported as no context.\n */\nasync function loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    commentRows: readonly WorkshopCommentRow[],\n): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorkshopCommentReference>> {\n    const answeredCommentIds = Array.from(\n        new Set(\n            commentRows\n                .map((commentRow) => commentRow.parent_comment_id)\n                .filter((parentCommentId): parentCommentId is string => parentCommentId !== null),\n        ),\n    );\n    if (answeredCommentIds.length === 0) {\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_REFERENCE_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId)\n        .in('id', answeredCommentIds);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the answered comments of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    return new Map(\n        ((data ?? attachedPollsResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n    if (stageCommentResult.errorMessage !== null) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: stageCommentResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    const commentRows = (commentsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopCommentRow[];\n    const [answeredCommentById, authorByParticipantId] = await Promise.all([\n        loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n        loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n    ]);\n\n    // Note: The administration moderates every room, so it reads the authors of the listed messages as they are.\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered: true,\n    };\n    const comments = commentRows.map((row): WorkshopAdminComment => ({\n        ...mapWorkshopCommentRow(row, false, roomContext),\n        participantId: row.participant_id,\n        isArtificial: row.is_artificial,\n        realUpvoteCount: row.upvote_count,\n        artificialUpvoteCount: row.artificial_upvote_count,\n        parentComment: row.parent_comment_id === null ? null : (answeredCommentById.get(row.parent_comment_id) ?? null),\n    }));\n    const linkClickCountByContentBlockId = new Map<string, number>(\n        ((contentLinkClickTotalsResult.data ?? Every state reload and every heartbeat of every\n *       participant would otherwise count the whole audience for nobody to read.\n * Note: An unavailable count must never take the whole room down with it, so a failure is reported as nobody watching.\n */\nexport async function countWatchingWorkshopParticipants(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<number> {\n    if (!isWorkshopPanelOffered(workshopRow.room_kind, workshopRow.disabled_panels, 'watching-count')) {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    const watchingSince = new Date(Date.now() - WORKSHOP_WATCHING_WINDOW_SECONDS * 1_000).toISOString();\n    const { count, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .gte('last_seen_at', watchingSince);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to count the participants watching a workshop:', error.message);\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    return (count ?? 0) + Math.max(0, workshopRow.artificial_watching_participant_count ?? 0);\n}\n\ntype LoadedWorkshopReactionCounts = {\n    readonly reactionCounts: readonly WorkshopReactionCount[];\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n};\n\n/**\n * Loads the totals shown beside the reactions which a room currently offers\n *\n * Note: When the reactions panel is hidden, nobody can read these totals. errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads one page of participants together with the activity totals used for its sortable columns.\n *\n * Note: The database applies the filters and sort before supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    query: WorkshopAdminParticipantQuery,\n): Promise<{ readonly page: WorkshopAdminParticipantPage | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const participantPageParameters = {\n        target_workshop_id: workshopId,\n        target_search_query: query.searchQuery,\n        target_is_trusted: query.isTrusted,\n        target_is_moderator: query.isModerator,\n        target_is_interaction_banned: query.isInteractionBanned,\n        target_registered_from: query.registeredFrom,\n        target_registered_to: return {\n            page: null,\n            errorMessage: reportSupabaseError(\n                `\\`${WORKSHOP_ADMIN_PARTICIPANT_PAGE_FUNCTION_NAME}\\``,\n                error,\n Shortened\n * material links are shareable, so they correctly belong to the material-wide\n * aggregate instead of this participant-attributed timeline.\n */\nexport async function .eq('participant_id', participantId)\n                .order('created_at', { ascending: true })\n                .order('id', { ascending: true })\n                .range(fromIndex, toIndex),\n        ),\n        loadAllSupabaseRows<WorkshopCommentUpvoteRow>((fromIndex, toIndex) =>\n            supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_UPVOTE_TABLE_NAME)\n                .select('id, comment_id, commentsResult.errorMessage ??\n        reactionsResult.errorMessage ??\n        upvotesResult.errorMessage ??\n        null;\n    if (firstErrorMessage !== null) {\n        return { timeline: null, errorMessage: firstErrorMessage };\n    }\n\n    if (participantResult.data === null) {\n        return { timeline: null, errorMessage: null };\n    }\n\n    const participant = participantResult.data as WorkshopAdminParticipantRow;\n    const commentRows = commentsResult.rows ?? []).map((comment) => [comment.id, comment] as const),\n    );\n    const events: WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent[] = [\n        { kind: 'joined' as const, id: `joined-${participant.id}`, occurredAt: participant.connected_at },\n        { kind: 'last-seen' as const, id: `last-seen-${participant.id}`, occurredAt: participant.last_seen_at },\n        ...commentRows.map((comment): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => ({\n            kind: 'comment',\n            id: comment.id,\n            occurredAt: comment.created_at,\n            body: comment.body,\n            status: comment.status,\n        })),\n        ...reactionRows.map((reaction): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => ({\n            kind: 'reaction',\n            id: reaction.id,\n            occurredAt: reaction.created_at,\n            emoji: reaction.emoji,\n        })),\n        ...upvoteRows.map((upvote): WorkshopParticipantTimelineEvent => {\n            const comment = upvotedCommentById.get(upvote.comment_id);\n            return {\n                kind: 'upvote',\n                id: upvote.id,\n                occurredAt: upvote.created_at,\n                commentId: upvote.comment_id,\n                commentAuthorName: comment?.author_name ?? A very busy room is sampled from its newest messages, because those are the ones a\n *       graph of it is read for.\n */\nasync function loadWorkshopAdminCommentSamples(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<{\n    readonly commentSamples: readonly WorkshopAdminCommentSample[] | null;\n    readonly isCommentSampleComplete: boolean;\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n}> {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('body, created_at')\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\n        .limit(MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT + 1);\n\n    if (error) {\n        return { commentSamples: null, isCommentSampleComplete: false, errorMessage: error.message };\n    }\n\n    const rows = (data ?? []) as WorkshopAdminCommentSampleRow[];\n    const isCommentSampleComplete = rows.length <= MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT;\n\n    return {\n        commentSamples: rows\n            .slice(0, MAXIMAL_WORKSHOP_ADMIN_COMMENT_SAMPLE_COUNT)\n            .map((row) => ({ occurredAt: row.created_at, body: row.body }))\n            .reverse(),\n        isCommentSampleComplete,\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads compact workshop-wide timeline buckets and reaction totals for the overview and reactions sections.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminAnalytics(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<{ readonly analytics: WorkshopAdminAnalytics | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const bucketDurationSeconds = getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow);\n    const timelineArguments = {\n        target_workshop_id: workshopRow.id,\n        target_bucket_seconds: bucketDurationSeconds,\n    };\n    const [timelineResult, reactionTimelineResult, reactionCountsResult, commentSampleResult] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_admin_timeline', timelineArguments),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_admin_reaction_timeline', timelineArguments),\n        supabase.rpc('get_workshop_reaction_counts', { target_workshop_id: workshopRow.id }),\n        loadWorkshopAdminCommentSamples(supabase, workshopRow),\n    ]);\n    const firstError =\n        timelineResult.error ??\n        reactionTimelineResult.error ??\n        reactionCountsResult.error ??\n        (commentSampleResult.errorMessage === null ? null : { message: commentSampleResult.errorMessage });\n    if (firstError) {\n        return { analytics: null, errorMessage: firstError.message };\n    }\n\n    const reactionCountsByBucket = groupWorkshopAdminReactionTimelineRows(\n        (reactionTimelineResult.data ?? [],\n            isCommentSampleComplete: commentSampleResult.isCommentSampleComplete,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads every participant which matches the [...firstPageResult.page.participants];\n    const totalPageCount = Math.ceil(firstPageResult.page.totalCount / exportQuery.pageSize);\n    for (let currentPage = 2; currentPage <= totalPageCount; return { participants, errorMessage: null };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads all comments for a CSV export, without inheriting the short moderation list used by the interactive screen.\n */\nexport async function []) as WorkshopContentRow[]).map((contentBlock) =>\n            mapWorkshopContentRow(contentBlock, linkClickCountByContentBlockId.get(contentBlock.id) ?? 0),\n        ),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Lists the feedback from one workshop only for the administration.\n *\n * Feedback and participants stay separate source records, just as comments and reactions do. The small identity read\n * keeps this list attributable without ever exposing an e-mail address through the participant-facing state route.\n */\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminFeedback(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n): Promise<{ readonly feedbacks: readonly WorkshopAdminFeedback[] | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const feedbackResult = await loadAllSupabaseRows<WorkshopFeedbackRow>(\n        (fromIndex, toIndex) =>\n            supabase\n                .from(WORKSHOP_FEEDBACK_TABLE_NAME)\n           .range(fromIndex, toIndex),\n        `the feedback of workshop ${workshopId}`,\n    );\n    if (feedbackResult.rows === null) {\n        return { feedbacks: null, errorMessage: .filter((feedback): feedback is WorkshopAdminFeedback => feedback !== null),\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the message pinned on top of a chat, whatever its age and Note: A pin which could not be loaded must never take the whole room down with it, so a failure is reported as\n *       nothing being pinned.\n */\nasync function return null;\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('id', workshopRow.pinned_comment_id)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the pinned comment of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    return data as WorkshopCommentRow | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Adds the pinned message to the loaded ones, so the room keeps a pin on top however old it WorkshopCommentRow[],\n    pinnedCommentRow: WorkshopCommentRow | null,\n): readonly WorkshopCommentRow[] {\n    if (\n        pinnedCommentRow === null ||\n        pinnedCommentRow.status !== message on top of a chat or releases the top of that chat again\n *\n * Note: The workshop remembers a single pin, so pinning a message releases the previously pinned one in the same write.\n * Note: Releasing the top only clears this very message, so it never drops a pin which another tab set meanwhile.\n */\nexport async function updatePinnedWorkshopComment(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n pinnedCommentQuery.eq('pinned_comment_id', commentId));\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to change the pinned comment of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return { errorMessage: 'Pinned comment could not be changed' };\n    }\n\n    return { errorMessage: null };\n}\n\n/**\n * Chooses the one comment the host is answering over the stage, or leaves the stage without a question.\n *\n * Note: The database checks that a selected comment belongs to this room. The stage keeps no copied text: the selected\n *       comment remains the one source of the question in both chat and live presentation.\n */\nexport async function updateWorkshopStageComment(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    stageCommentId: string | null,\n): Promise<{ readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const { error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_TABLE_NAME)\n        .update({ stage_comment_id: stageCommentId })\n        .eq('id', workshopId);\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to change the comment on a workshop stage:', error.message);\n        return { errorMessage: 'Stage comment could not be changed' };\n    }\n\n    return { errorMessage: null };\n}\n\nexport async function loadWorkshopPublicState(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    participant: WorkshopParticipant,\n    commentSort: WorkshopCommentSort,\n): Promise<LoadedWorkshopPublicState> {\n    const contentVisibilityCutoff = new Date().toISOString();\n    const workshop = mapWorkshopRow(workshopRow);\n    const isWorkshopPast = workshopRow.room_kind === 'workshop' && getWorkshopPhase(workshop) === 'past';\n\n    // Note: The reactions which flew over the stage recently are replayed for somebody entering the room. A room\n    //       without that panel therefore does not load them, exactly as it does not count them.\n    const isReactionsPanelOffered = isWorkshopPanelOffered(\n        workshopRow.room_kind,\n        workshopRow.disabled_panels,\n        'reactions',\n    );\n    const roomCapabilities = getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopRow.room_kind);\n    const isStageOffered = roomCapabilities.isStageOffered;\n\n    // Note: The membership decides which materials a member sees, so the room asks about it before it assembles what\n    //       is visible. A room which does not offer the membership has nothing to unlock, and an answer which does\n    //       not arrive keeps the paid materials hidden rather than letting them escape.\n    let isPaidMember = false;\n    if (roomCapabilities.isMembershipOffered) {\n        const { membership, errorMessage: membershipErrorMessage } = await loadCommunityMembershipByEmail(\n            supabase,\n            participant.email,\n        );\n        if (membershipErrorMessage !== null) {\n            console.error('Failed to load the community membership of a workshop participant:', membershipErrorMessage);\n        }\n        isPaidMember = membership !== null && isPaidCommunityMembershipStatus(membership.status);\n    }\n\n    // Note: A moderator is shown every message which waits for a decision, because making that decision is exactly\n    //       what they are in the room for. A room\n *       which lasts for days is measured more coarsely, so that the answer stays small however long it has been open.\n */\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineBucketDurationSeconds(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): number {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const currentMilliseconds = Date.now();\n    const configuredEndsAtMilliseconds =\n        workshopRow.ends_at === null ? currentMilliseconds : Date.parse(workshopRow.ends_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = Math.max(startsAtMilliseconds, configuredEndsAtMilliseconds);\n    const durationMilliseconds = endsAtMilliseconds - startsAtMilliseconds;\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 2 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 60;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 8 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 300;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 900;\n    }\n\n    if (durationMilliseconds <= 30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000) {\n        return 3_600;\n    }\n\n    return 86_400;\n}\n\nfunction getWorkshopAdminTimelineEndsAt(workshopRow: WorkshopRow): string {\n    const startsAtMilliseconds = Date.parse(workshopRow.starts_at);\n    const endsAtMilliseconds = workshopRow.ends_at === null ? Every state reload and every heartbeat of every\n *       participant would otherwise count the whole audience for nobody to read.\n * Note: An unavailable count must never take the whole room down with it, so a failure is reported as nobody watching.\n */\nexport async function countWatchingWorkshopParticipants(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n): Promise<number> {\n    if (!isWorkshopPanelOffered(workshopRow.room_kind, workshopRow.disabled_panels, 'watching-count')) {\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    const watchingSince = new Date(Date.now() - WORKSHOP_WATCHING_WINDOW_SECONDS * 1_000).toISOString();\n    const { count, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n        .gte('last_seen_at', watchingSince);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to count the participants watching a workshop:', error.message);\n        return 0;\n    }\n\n    return (count ?? 0) + Math.max(0, workshopRow.artificial_watching_participant_count ?? 0);\n}\n\ntype LoadedWorkshopReactionCounts = {\n    readonly reactionCounts: readonly WorkshopReactionCount[];\n    readonly errorMessage: string | null;\n};\n\n/**\n * Loads the totals shown beside the reactions which a room currently offers\n *\n * Note: When the reactions panel is hidden, nobody can read these totals. undefined : authorByParticipantId.get(commentRow.participant_id);\n            if (\n                !areWorkshopCommentLinksEnabled({\n                    isArtificial: commentRow.is_artificial,\n                    isAuthorModerator: author?.isModerator ?? []) as WorkshopReactionRow[]).map(mapWorkshopReactionRow),\n            reactionCounts: reactionCountsResult.reactionCounts,\n            polls: pollsResult.polls,\n        },\n        errorMessage: null,\n    };\n}\n\n/**\n * Loads the comments answered by the listed ones, so moderation of a reply sees the question it answers\n *\n * Note: The listed comments are filtered by one moderation status, so an answered comment is almost never among them.\n * Note: Missing context must never take the whole administration down with it, so a failure is reported as no context.\n */\nasync function loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopId: string,\n    commentRows: readonly WorkshopCommentRow[],\n): Promise<ReadonlyMap<string, WorkshopCommentReference>> {\n    const answeredCommentIds = Array.from(\n        new Set(\n            commentRows\n                .map((commentRow) => commentRow.parent_comment_id)\n                .filter((parentCommentId): parentCommentId is string => parentCommentId !== null),\n        ),\n    );\n    if (answeredCommentIds.length === 0) {\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_TABLE_NAME)\n        .select(WORKSHOP_COMMENT_REFERENCE_COLUMNS)\n        .eq('workshop_id', workshopId)\n        .in('id', answeredCommentIds);\n\n    if (error) {\n        console.error('Failed to load the answered comments of a workshop:', error.message);\n        return new Map();\n    }\n\n    return new Map(\n        ((data ?? []) as readonly WorkshopCommentReferenceRow[]).map(\n            (commentRow) => [commentRow.id, mapWorkshopCommentReferenceRow(commentRow)] as const,\n        ),\n    );\n}\n\ntype WorkshopAdminSnapshotOptions = {\n    /**\n     * Whether the currently opened administration section needs the list of moderated comments.\n     */\n    readonly isCommentsIncluded: boolean;\n};\n\nexport async function loadWorkshopAdminSnapshot(\n    supabase: SupabaseClient,\n    workshopRow: WorkshopRow,\n    commentStatus: WorkshopCommentStatus,\n    options: WorkshopAdminSnapshotOptions = { isCommentsIncluded: true },\n): Promise<{ readonly snapshot: WorkshopAdminSnapshot | null; readonly errorMessage: string | null }> {\n    const [\n        contentResult,\n        commentsResult,\n        commentsCountResult,\n        participantCountResult,\n        contentLinkClickTotalsResult,\n        reactionsResult,\n        artificialReactionsResult,\n        pinnedCommentRow,\n        stageCommentResult,\n        pollsResult,\n        attachedPollsResult,\n    ] = await Promise.all([\n        supabase\n            .from(WORKSHOP_CONTENT_TABLE_NAME)\n            .select(WORKSHOP_CONTENT_COLUMNS)\n            .eq('workshop_id', workshopRow.id)\n            .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })\n            .order('unlock_at', { ascending: true }),\n        options.isCommentsIncluded\n            ? attachedPollsResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n    if (stageCommentResult.errorMessage !== null) {\n        return { snapshot: null, errorMessage: stageCommentResult.errorMessage };\n    }\n\n    const commentRows = (commentsResult.data ?? []) as WorkshopCommentRow[];\n    const [answeredCommentById, authorByParticipantId] = await Promise.all([\n        loadAnsweredWorkshopComments(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n        loadWorkshopCommentAuthors(supabase, workshopRow.id, commentRows),\n    ]);\n\n    // Note: The administration moderates every room, so it reads the authors of the listed messages as they are.\n    const roomContext: WorkshopCommentRoomContext = {\n        pinnedCommentId: workshopRow.pinned_comment_id,\n        authorByParticipantId,\n        isModerationOffered: true,\n    };\n    const comments = commentRows.map((row): WorkshopAdminComment => ({\n        ...mapWorkshopCommentRow(row, false, roomContext),\n        participantId: row.participant_id,\n        isArtificial: row.is_artificial,\n        realUpvoteCount: row.upvote_count,\n        artificialUpvoteCount: row.artificial_upvote_count,\n        parentComment: row.parent_comment_id === null ? null : (answeredCommentById.get(row.parent_comment_id) ?? null),\n    }));\n    const linkClickCountByContentBlockId = new Map<string, number>(\n        ((contentLinkClickTotalsResult.data ?? '@/lib/workshops/workshopTypes';\n\n/**\n * What a room of one kind is, so that a screen asks for the capability it needs instead of naming the kind itself\n */\nexport type WorkshopKindCapabilities = {\n    /**\n     * Whether exactly one room of this kind exists, so nothing offers a choice between rooms or the creation of another\n     */\n    readonly isSingleton: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether the URL of a room is decided once and for all, so its administration neither offers it nor lets an edit\n     * disconnect the links leading to it\n     */\n    readonly isSlugFixed: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room happens at a time, so it has a start, an end, and a countdown towards it\n     */\n    readonly isScheduled: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room is one term of a public event, so it says which kind of event it is, where it is held, what it\n     * costs, and how many people fit into it\n     */\n    readonly isEvent: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room gathers its participants around a shared stage with a video stream\n     */\n    readonly isStageOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room can be about a project, so its administration connects a repository to it and the room shows what\n     * is being built in that repository while the room runs\n     */\n    readonly isRepositoryOffered: boolean;\n\n    /** Whether a room can give every participant a presentation beside its ordinary materials. */\n    readonly isPresentationOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether the room offers member polls, which are currently the permanent community's way to make a decision\n     * together without turning an individual live workshop into a survey.\n     */\n    readonly isPollsOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether this room can show a community poll which is attached to it. A workshop occurrence is the subject of\n     * such a poll rather than its owner, so it shows and changes the one common e-mail-owned vote there.\n     */\n    readonly isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room says which membership of the community the connected member has, and lets them buy and manage it\n     * without leaving the room\n     *\n     * Note: The membership belongs to the address a member connects with rather than to one room, so every room which\n     *       offers it reads and changes the very same membership.\n     */\n    readonly isMembershipOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room leads its participants on into the permanent community, which is where everything outlasting one\n     * term is kept\n     *\n     * Note: The community never invites anybody into itself, and a project discussion is opened from the community\n     *       which already showed that project, so only a room a member can reach without the community offers the way\n     *       there.\n     */\n    readonly isCommunityInvitationOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a participant can end their own session in this room and be offered its connection form again, which\n     * they read as signing out of it\n     *\n     * Note: Only a room a participant connected to themselves is left this way. The session of a project discussion is\n     *       made out of the community session which opened it, so signing out there would be undone by the very next\n     *       visit; a member of a project discussion signs out of the community instead.\n     */\n    readonly isDisconnectionOffered: boolean;\n\n    /**\n     * Whether a room updates itself while it is open, which its broadcast, its reactions, and its watching count need\n     */\n    readonly isRealtime: boolean;\n};\n\n/**\n * Every room kind together with what it is\n *\n * Note: A workshop occurrence is the live event this infrastructure was built for. The community reuses the very same\n *       secured room, but is one permanent, calm space rather than an occurrence which starts, streams, and ends.\n * Note: This is the one place a room kind is described. Every screen reads it, so a kind added later needs no change\n *       of the room, of its administration, or of the routes behind them.\n */\nconst WORKSHOP_KIND_CAPABILITY_DEFINITIONS: Readonly<Record<WorkshopKind, WorkshopKindCapabilities>> = {\n    workshop: {\n        isSingleton: false,\n        isSlugFixed: false,\n        isScheduled: true,\n        isEvent: true,\n        isStageOffered: true,\n        isRepositoryOffered: true,\n        isPresentationOffered: true,\n        isPollsOffered: false,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: true,\n        isMembershipOffered: true,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: true,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n        isRealtime: true,\n    },\n    community: {\n        isSingleton: true,\n        isSlugFixed: true,\n        isScheduled: false,\n        isEvent: false,\n        isStageOffered: false,\n        isRepositoryOffered: false,\n        isPresentationOffered: false,\n        isPollsOffered: true,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n        isMembershipOffered: true,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: true,\n        isRealtime: false,\n    },\n    project: {\n        isSingleton: false,\n        isSlugFixed: true,\n        isScheduled: false,\n        isEvent: false,\n        isStageOffered: false,\n        isRepositoryOffered: false,\n        isPresentationOffered: false,\n        isPollsOffered: false,\n        isAttachedCommunityPollsShown: false,\n        isMembershipOffered: false,\n        isCommunityInvitationOffered: false,\n        isDisconnectionOffered: false,\n        isRealtime: false,\n    },\n};\n\nexport function getWorkshopKindCapabilities(workshopKind: WorkshopKind): WorkshopKindCapabilities {\n    return WORKSHOP_KIND_CAPABILITY_DEFINITIONS[workshopKind];\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether a member room can show and vote on visible community polls. <>\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Typ akce\n                <select\n                    value={event.type}\n {EVENT_TYPE_DEFINITION_LIST.map((eventTypeDefinition) => (\n                        <option key={eventTypeDefinition.id} value={eventTypeDefinition.id}>\n                            {eventTypeDefinition.label}\n                        </option>\n                    ))}\n                </select>\n                <span className=\"mt-1 block text-xs font-normal text-slate-400\">\n                   required\n                    />\n                </label>\n            )}\n\n            <label className=\"text-sm font-medium text-slate-700\">\n                Cena za účastníka            onChange({ ...event, priceCzk: readPriceCzk(changeEvent.target.value) })\n                    }\n                    className=\"mt-2\"\n                />\n                <span A permanent room which is no term of an event has no such page and offers no link.\n */\nexport function WorkshopEventLinks({ workshop }: WorkshopEventLinksProps) {\n    const eventLink = createPublicEventLinkOrNull(workshop);\n    if (workshop.event === null || eventLink === null) {\n        return null;\n    }\n\n    // Note: A kind of event without a live room leads to its landing page already, so that page is offered a second\n    //       time only where it is really somewhere else than the term itself.\n    const { label: eventTypeLabel, landingPagePath } = getEventTypeDefinition(workshop.event.type);\n    const isLandingPageSeparate = landingPagePath !== eventLink;\n\n    return (\n        <section className=\"rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm\">\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n                <div className=\"min-w-0\">\n                    <h2 className=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-950\">\n                        <Globe className=\"h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-cyan-600\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> {eventTypeLabel} na webu\n                    </h2>\n                    <p className=\"mt-1 break-all font-mono text-xs text-slate-500\">{eventLink}</p>\n                    {!workshop.isPublished && <p className=\"mt-1 text-xs text-amber-600\">{UNPUBLISHED_EVENT_NOTE}</p>}\n                </div>\n\n                <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2\">\n                    <Button asChild size=\"sm\">\n                        <a href={eventLink} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">\n                            <ExternalLink className=\"mr-1.5 h-4 w-4\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Otevřít akci\n                        </a>\n                    </Button>\n                    {isLandingPageSeparate && (\n                        <Button asChild variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\">\n                            <a href={landingPagePath} target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">\n                                <ExternalLink className=\"mr-1.5 h-4 w-4\" aria-hidden=\"true\" /> Landing page akce\n                            </a>\n                        </Button>\n                    )}\n                </div>\n            </div>\n        </section>\n    );\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":30,"oldLines":9,"newStart":30,"newLines":10,"lines":["     }"," ","     // Note: A kind of event without a live room leads to its landing page already, so that A future English route can provide its own factory without\n * duplicating the room mechanics or tying a translation to a database row.\n */\nexport function createCzechCommunityConnectionDetails(community: WorkshopDetails): WorkshopConnectionDetails {\n    return {\n        title: community.title,\n        description: community.description,\n        dateLabel: 'Kdykoli online',\n        durationLabel: 'Stálý přístup',\n        roomLabel: 'Komunita Promptbooku',\n        connectionHeading: 'Připojit se do komunity',\n        connectionDescription: 'Jméno se zobrazí u vašich komentářů. Odkaz vás vezme přímo do místnosti workshopu se stejnými údaji, u placených akcí na jejich stránku.',\n    emptyMessage: 'Zatím není publikovaný žádný termín. Chat zůstává otevřený, ostatní členové tam sdílejí, na čem pracují, a všechny další termíny najdete na jednom místě.',\n    sectionTitles: [\n        CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.projectsTitle,\n        CZECH_COMMUNITY_ROOM_COPY.materialsTitle,\n        CZECH_COMMUNITY_WORKSHOP_NAVIGATION_COPY.title,\n    ],\n    linkLabel: CZECH_COMMUNITY_ENTRY_LABEL,\n} as const;\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":45,"oldLines":7,"newStart":45,"newLines":7,"lines":[" export const CZECH_COMMUNITY_WORKSHOP_NAVIGATION_COPY = {","     title: 'Termíny akcí Promptbooku',","     description:","-        'Vyberte si termín v kalendáři nebo v kartách. { DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS } from '@/lib/events/event';\nimport {\n    createEventLinkOrNull,\n    createLocalEventLinkOrNull,\n    createPublicEventLinkOrNull,\n} from '@/lib/events/eventLinks';\nimport };\nconst EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE_URL = 'https://konference.example.com/program';\n\nconst ONLINE_WORKSHOP_TERM: WorkshopSummary = {\n    id: 'online-workshop-id',\n    kind: 'workshop',\n    event: locationLabel: 'Praha' },\n};\n\nconst EXTERNAL_CONFERENCE_TERM: WorkshopSummary = {\n    ...ONLINE_WORKSHOP_TERM,\n    id: 'external-conference-id',\n    slug: 'webexpo-2026-09-24',\n    title: ...ONLINE_WORKSHOP_TERM,\n    id: 'community-id',\n    kind: 'community',\n    event: null,\n    slug: 'komunita',\n    title: 'Komunita Promptbooku',\n};\n\ndescribe('event links', () => {\n '/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=production-ai-2026-09-10&email=jana%40example.com&fullname=Jana+Nov%C3%A1kov%C3%A1',\n        );\n    });\n\n    it('leads a term without a room to the within } from '@testing-library/react';\nimport { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nconst TERM_LIST_LABEL = 'Termíny akcí';\n\nconst SERVER_TIME = '2026-09-10T19:30:00+02:00';\nconst CALENDAR_FEED_URL = 'https://ptbk.io/cs/komunita/calendar.ics';\nconst PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY = { fullname: 'Jana Nováková', email: 'jana@example.com' };\n\nconst ONGOING_WORKSHOP: WorkshopSummary = {\n    id: 'ongoing-workshop-id',\n    kind: 'workshop',\n    event: DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS,\n    slug: 'production-ai-2026-09-10',\n    title: 'Produkční kód s AI agenty',\n    description: 'Online workshop s Pavolem Hejným a Jiřím Jahnem',\n    startsAt: '2026-09-10T19:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: '2026-09-10T20:30:00+02:00',\n    isPublished: true,\n};\n\nconst UPCOMING_WORKSHOP: WorkshopSummary = {\n    ...ONGOING_WORKSHOP,\n    id: 'upcoming-workshop-id',\n    slug: 'ai-supervize-mini-2026-09-24',\n    title: 'AI Supervize Mini',\n    event: {\n        ...DEFAULT_EVENT_DETAILS,\n        type: 'ai-supervize-mini',\n        locationKind: 'onsite',\n        locationLabel: 'Praha',\n        priceCzk: 12000,\n    },\n    startsAt: '2026-09-24T10:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: AI agenty v červenci',\n    startsAt: '2026-07-10T19:00:00+02:00',\n    endsAt: '2026-07-10T20:30:00+02:00',\n};\n\nconst WORKSHOPS: readonly WorkshopSummary[] = [PAST_WORKSHOP, ONGOING_WORKSHOP, UPCOMING_WORKSHOP];\n\nfunction renderWorkshopLinksPanel(workshops: readonly WorkshopSummary[] = WORKSHOPS) {\n    render(\n        <WorkshopLinksPanel\n            workshops={workshops}\n            participantIdentity={PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY}\n            title=\"Termíny akcí Promptbooku\"\n            description=\"Vyberte si termín.\"\n            emptyMessage=\"Žádný termín není dostupný.\"\n            locale=\"cs-CZ\"\n            timeZone=\"Europe/Prague\"\n            serverTime={SERVER_TIME}\n            calendarFeedUrl={CALENDAR_FEED_URL}\n        />,\n    );\n}\n\nfunction findCalendarDay(dayKey: string): HTMLElement {\n    return screen.getByRole('button', { name: formatCalendarDayTitle(dayKey, 'cs-CZ') });\n}\n\nfunction findTermLinks(): readonly HTMLElement[] {\n    return within(screen.getByRole('list', { name: TERM_LIST_LABEL })).getAllByRole('link');\n}\n\nfunction showCardsView(): void {\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Karty' }));\n}\n\nafterEach(cleanup);\n\ndescribe('workshop links panel', () => {\n    it('opens on the calendar of the month a member is in', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(screen.getAllByText('září 2026').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /v červenci/ })).toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('colours every day of the calendar by where the term held on it stands in time', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-10').className).toContain(\n            getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('ongoing').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24').className).toContain(\n            getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('upcoming').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-11').getAttribute('disabled')).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('narrows the listed terms to the chosen day and back to the whole month', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        fireEvent.click(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24'));\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /AI Supervize Mini/ })).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).toBeNull();\n\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Celý měsíc' }));\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('lists every term of every month once the cards are chosen', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        expect(findTermLinks().map((termLink) => termLink.textContent)).toEqual([\n            expect.stringContaining(ONGOING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(UPCOMING_WORKSHOP.title),\n            expect.stringContaining(PAST_WORKSHOP.title),\n        ]);\n    });\n\n    it('says on every card whether its term is running, still ahead, or already over', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        const [ongoingCard, upcomingCard, pastCard] = findTermLinks();\n\n        expect(ongoingCard?.textContent).toContain('Probíhá');\n        expect(upcomingCard?.textContent).toContain('Nadchází');\n        expect(pastCard?.textContent).toContain('Proběhlo');\n    });\n\n    it('links a community member to every workshop room with their identity prefilled', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        expect(findTermLinks()[0]?.getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            '/cs/online-workshop/participant?workshop=production-ai-2026-09-10&email=jana%40example.com&fullname=Jana+Nov%C3%A1kov%C3%A1',\n        );\n    });\n\n    it('leads a term of a paid workshop to its landing page instead of a room it does not have', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        const paidWorkshopLink = screen.getByRole('link', { name: /AI Supervize Mini/ });\n\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.getAttribute('href')).toBe('/ai-supervize-mini');\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.textContent).toContain('Praha');\n        expect(paidWorkshopLink.textContent).toContain(formatEventPrice(12000));\n    });\n\n    it('offers the whole calendar to the calendar application of a member', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Google/ }).getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            'https://calendar.google.com/calendar/r?cid=webcal%3A%2F%2Fptbk.io%2Fcs%2Fkomunita%2Fcalendar.ics',\n        );\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Jiná kalendářová aplikace/ }).getAttribute('href')).toBe(\n            'webcal://ptbk.io/cs/komunita/calendar.ics',\n        );\n    });\n\n    it('explains an empty list of terms without offering a view of nothing', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel([]);\n\n        expect(screen.getByText('Žádný termín není dostupný.')).not.toBeNull();\n        expect(screen.queryByRole('link')).toBeNull();\n emptyMessage=\"Žádný termín není dostupný.\"\n            locale=\"cs-CZ\"\n            timeZone=\"Europe/Prague\"\n            serverTime={SERVER_TIME}\n    );\n        expect(findCalendarDay('2026-09-24').className).toContain(\n            getWorkshopPhaseAppearance('upcoming').calendarDayClassName,\n        );\n expect(screen.queryByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).toBeNull();\n\n        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Celý měsíc' }));\n\n        expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: /Produkční kód s AI agenty/ })).not.toBeNull();\n    });\n\n    it('lists every term of every month once the cards are chosen', () => {\n it('says on every card whether its term is running, still ahead, or already over', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n        showCardsView();\n\n        const [ongoingCard, upcomingCard, expect(pastCard?.textContent).toContain('Proběhlo');\n    });\n\n    it('links a community member to every workshop room with their identity prefilled', () => {\n        renderWorkshopLinksPanel();\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011Cf6xSXs8TntzaReu7kySe","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01AotR3WwsAExXd1BMioEmSh","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\changelog\\_current-preversion.md","old_string":"# Current preversion\n\n- An administrator can now enable an `Other` answer for a community poll.","new_string":"# Current preversion\n\n- Let `/cs/komunita` list the conferences and workshops which lecturers of the community speak at elsewhere. A term of\n  the new `Externí akce` kind of event is administered in `/admin/workshops` beside every other term and carries one\n  thing the terms held here never do: the address of its organizer, which is where its card and its calendar day lead,\n  opened beside the room rather than instead of it. Because such an event is held by somebody else, this application runs no room and gathers no registration\n  for it: its administration says so rather than reporting an audience of nobody, the membership never returns a payer\n  to somebody else's website, and a term whose address is missing is refused when written and offered nowhere if it\n  was ever stored without one.\n\n- An administrator can now enable an `Other` answer for a community poll."},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":212,"cache_read_input_tokens":243374,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":212},"output_tokens":16,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"b7f2cd13-2785-4eb5-97ae-c4b928f3773c","uuid":"008ebcee-3ae7-48d2-bbd5-1b940343bbcb","timestamp":"2026-09-16T10:25:24.221Z","request_id":"req_011Cf6xSXL8QtJir7ZCbtcPn"}
